recipes.projection: Blended projection = weighted mean of Sleeper app x1, FantasyPros x1, CBS Sports x1, ESPN fantasy x1, DraftKings points converted from each source's own stat lines. Weights renormalise over the sources that cover each player; coverage is the covering weight as a share of the total enabled weight. Coverage under 50% keeps the number from the sources that do cover the player and is flagged "thin"; it is never pulled toward a typical score for the salary. No coverage leaves the projection blank, flagged "no projection", unless the injury report lists the player as out, on IR, doubtful or suspended, in which case the projection is 0.
recipes.ownership: Own% is the average, by source weight, of the numbers Weekly findings file, Footballguys percent rostered and RotoWire projected roster % published for the DraftKings main slate; numbers for any other site or slate are never used. Stokastic DK cheat sheet is downloaded, stored and shown in its own column, but never averaged into Own% (weight 0). A number Adam types into the Own% cell replaces the published one for that player. A player with no published number is left blank: the app never estimates ownership, so game popularity exists only where a real number does.
recipes.scoring: DraftKings scoring from stat lines; 100/300-yard bonuses paid as 3 x probability from a lognormal (cv rush 0.55, rec 0.55, pass 0.30); DST points-allowed from a normal around the opponent's implied total (SD 9.5, shutout rate unvalidated)

injury.comment: Smith-Njigba gathered in eight of 10 targets for 171 yards and one touchdown during Sunday's 21-13 win at Las Vegas.
injury.longComment: Smith-Njigba's Week 10 performance was fueled by a 71-yard catch and run for a touchdown in the middle of the third quarter, but he still was able to put up 100 yards on his other seven receptions en route to a new season high in the category. As the Seahawks hit their Week 11 bye, he's reached the century mark in receiving eight times and resides on a 79-1,207-10 line on 109 targets through 10 contests. Smith-Njigba's next chance to continue aggravating opposing defenses arrives Sunday, Nov. 29, at San Francisco.

injury.comment: Walker (groin), who won't play Sunday in Atlanta, is expected to "be able to go" next Sunday against the Cardinals, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
injury.longComment: Walker showed up at the Chiefs' facilities Friday with a tight groin, didn't take part in the ensuing practice and then was listed as questionable for Week 10 action. The team then ruled him out Saturday, which Rapoport called "more precautionary than anything else." In Walker's absence, rookie fifth-round pick Emmett Johnson is expected to be Kansas City's primary runner.

injury.comment: Nacua (knee/toe) has an expected return date of "mid-December," Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
injury.longComment: After the Rams placed Nacua on injured reserve Thursday, Nacua must miss at least four games, which means his earliest return date is Sunday, Dec. 20 against the Cowboys. Considering the timeline given in Rapoport's report, Nacua thus may miss only the minimum number of contests while on IR after suffering PCL and MCL sprains and also a turf-toe injury last Sunday at Washington. With Davante Adams (hamstring) out at least one more outing, L.A. is rolling with a receiving corps of Konata Mumpfield, Tutu Atwell, CJ Daniels, Xavier Smith and Brennan Presley in Week 10.

injury.comment: Lamb secured seven of 13 targets for 72 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Despite his own impressive numbers, Lamb played second fiddle to George Pickens for a change, as the latter doubled up the former in receptions and did the same with a yard to spare in receiving yards. Nevertheless, Lamb still put together a solid performance that included his eighth touchdown reception of the season, a spectacular leaping one-handed one-yard grab late in the fourth quarter. Lamb now is up to five consecutive double-digit target tallies and has at least 70 receiving yards in four of the last five contests heading into a Week 11 home matchup against the vulnerable Titans defense.

injury.comment: McCaffrey rushed 13 times for 62 yards and a touchdown and brought in all four targets for 161 yards and two more scores in the 49ers' 46-40 win over the Cowboys on Sunday. He also caught a two-point conversion pass.
injury.longComment: While McCaffrey's touches once again were kept below 20, the elite running back finished with a season-high total in yards from scrimmage with a career-best performance as a receiver. He struck first through the air, recording a 74-yard touchdown reception late in the first half. The versatile veteran then went in on the ground from 16 yards out early in the fourth quarter to extend San Francisco's lead to 38-19 at the time, before sealing the extremely hard-fought victory with a spectacular 66-yard catch-and-run TD on a slant and an ensuing two-point conversion grab with just over three minutes remaining after the Cowboys had closed to 38-32. McCaffrey has a relatively modest-by-his-standards 155 touches over nine games, but he's still just 50 yards short of 1,000 total yards for the season heading into next Sunday night's Week 11 home showdown against the Vikings.

injury.comment: Robinson rushed 16 times for 71 yards and a touchdown and brought in four of five targets for six yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.
injury.longComment: The Falcons were down 14-3 by halftime and 21-3 doing into the final period, so Robinson's opportunities progressively dwindled due to game script. However, the star running back still averaged a solid 4.4 yards per carry and recorded his sixth rushing touchdown of the season on a three-yard run in the fourth quarter. Robinson has at least four receptions in three of the last four games, and he'll now have a Week 11 bye to rest up before a tough Week 12 road matchup against the Vikings on Sunday, Nov. 29.

injury.comment: Taylor rushed 16 times for 83 yards and brought in two of four targets for 20 yards in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday. He also committed a fumble that stayed with Indianapolis.
injury.longComment: Taylor made it through the trade deadline unscathed after rumors swirled around a possible change of scenery, but the talented back still split plenty of work with rookie backfield mate Seth McGowan, who logged 12 carries. Taylor still remained the No. 1 option and was the only one of the two to see any targets, and the rushing yardage total was his best since Week 7, just before serious trade speculation began. Taylor is staying put for the rest of the campaign, but it seems likely that he'll continue ceding a fair share of touches to McGowan moving forward.

injury.comment: Watson caught three of five targets for 37 yards in Sunday's 30-10 loss to Minnesota.
injury.longComment: The Packers' passing game was stifled as the Vikings sacked Jordan Love eight times, giving him little time to find receivers like Watson. The 37 yards were a season low for the fifth-year wideout, while the three grabs tied for his lowest volume of 2026. Watson will take a 52-916-7 line on 79 targets through 10 contests into a Week 11 bye before facing the Rams in Week 12.

injury.comment: Bowers, who will undergo additional testing Monday, is not believed to have suffered a major ankle injury in Sunday's loss to the Seahawks, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
injury.longComment: Per Rapoport, at this stage Bowers is viewed as "more day-to-day" as the Raiders' Week 11 contest against the Broncos approaches. That said, at a minimum, it seems likely that the tight end's practice participation will be impacted in the coming days, given that he was in and out the the lineup versus Seattle as he contended with his ankle issue.

injury.comment: Allen completed 11 of 21 passes for 196 yards, one touchdown and one interception while rushing five times for five yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 31-12 win over the Jets.
injury.longComment: Allen scored one-yard rushing touchdowns in the first and third quarters, bringing his season total up to 11 rushing TDs. He added his 13th touchdown pass of the campaign on a 45-yard strike to DJ Moore later in the third quarter, and Allen's fourth-quarter interception on third-and-long was basically an arm punt. Heading into a Week 11 home game against the Dolphins, the star QB has accounted for multiple touchdowns in all but one outing this season.

injury.comment: Williams rushed 16 times for 63 yards and brought in his only target for four yards in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Williams had a near monopoly on the Cowboys' running back touches, but he worked hard for everything he got against a talented 49ers front seven. The veteran back averaged under 4.0 yards per carry for the seventh time this season, but he did eclipse 60 rushing yards for the third time in the last four games. Williams will take 692 rushing yards and nine rush TDs -- along with a 25-131-1 receiving line -- into a Week 11 home matchup against the Titans next Sunday.

injury.comment: Cook rushed 18 times for 157 yards and a touchdown and didn't catch his only target in Sunday's 31-12 win over the Jets.
injury.longComment: Buffalo relied primarily on its ground game in the lopsided victory, as Cook's 74-yard touchdown run in the fourth quarter provided the cherry on top after a pair of one-yard Josh Allen rushing scores helped the Bills pull away. Cook extended his touchdown streak to eight games by scoring his ninth rushing TD over that span. He has topped 100 scrimmage yards in all but one game during the productive stretch, bouncing back effectively after being held to 69 scoreless yards by the Texans in the season opener. Cook has a nice opportunity to keep rolling in Week 11, when the 8-1 Bills host the 1-8 Dolphins.

injury.comment: Golden caught five of nine targets for 70 yards in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.
injury.longComment: The second-year wideout was the only Packer to have much success on offense, leading the team in catches, targets and receiving yards. Golden has reached 70 yards in three straight games and five of the last six, and he heads into a Week 11 bye with a 58-853-5 line on 101 targets through 10 contests. His next chance to add to those numbers will come in Week 12 against the Rams.

injury.comment: Hubbard carried the ball 27 times for 92 yards and two touchdowns and caught all five of his targets for 80 yards in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Saints.
injury.longComment: The 27-year-old RB kept the Panthers' offense afloat nearly single-handedly, as he set a new career high with 172 scrimmage yards while scoring both the team's TDs, on a two-yard run in the first quarter and a one-yard plunge in the fourth. Hubbard's 80 receiving yards were easily a new career high, topping the 3-57-0 line on three targets he recorded in Week 15 of the 2022 season against the Steelers. Over Hubbard's last six games, he surged to 697 scrimmage yards and six rushing touchdowns, and he'll look keep rolling in a Week 11 clash with the Ravens.

injury.comment: Williams rushed 12 times for 23 yards and brought in two of five targets for nine yards in the Rams' 34-6 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Williams was held well under 4.0 yards per carry for the third consecutive game, but Sunday's performance was particularly alarming in that he averaged a minuscule 1.9 yards per carry. In contrast, Blake Corum (17-100-1) and Ronnie Rivers (15-81-0, albeit in garbage time) both had multiple productive runs on the way to efficient afternoons, making Williams' struggles stand out all the more. With Corum particularly playing well in the last several weeks, Williams could be relegated to a clear complementary role in a Week 12 Thanksgiving Eve home showdown with the Packers on Nov. 25, following a Week 11 bye.

injury.comment: McBride tallied five catches on as many targets for 37 yards during Sunday's 34-6 loss to the Rams.
injury.longComment: McBride's streak of at least seven catches ended at 11 games, and his receiving yardage total marked his second-fewest of the campaign in what doubled as rookie QB Carson Beck's first NFL start. Better days likely are ahead for the duo, but as McBride works with his third signal-caller this season -- and the least experienced one at that after Jacoby Brissett and Gardner Minshew -- there may be more lows than highs for the tight end over the final seven contests. McBride will look to bounce back next Sunday at Kansas City.

injury.comment: Purdy completed 22 of 28 passes for 389 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions and added two carries for 21 yards in the 49ers' 46-40 win over the Cowboys on Sunday. He also threw a two-point conversion pass.
injury.longComment: As expected, Sunday's showdown between the longtime rivals turned into a complete offensive showcase, and Purdy was right at the center of the fireworks. The veteran quarterback recorded a career-high passing yardage total, with his 66-yard touchdown pass to Christian McCaffrey with just over three minutes remaining putting Purdy over the top. That TD toss was preceded by 11- and 74-yard scoring strikes to Deebo Samuel and McCaffrey, respectively, in the first half, giving Purdy his third tally of at least three touchdown passes this season. Purdy's 78.6 percent completion rate also was his second-highest total of the season, and the fact the star signal-caller seemed to have quick chemistry with trade-deadline acquisition Keenan Allen bodes very well, considering Purdy also may have Mike Evans (Achilles) back for next Sunday night's Week 11 home showdown against the Vikings.

injury.comment: Olave caught three of four targets for 30 yards in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Panthers.
injury.longComment: The game wound up being Jordyn Tyson's breakout performance, as the rookie WR hauled in 11 of 13 targets for 80 yards, but that didn't leave much volume for Olave or any other Saint. With Tyler Shough struggling, it's unclear whether the passing game can keep more than one pass catcher fantasy-relevant at a time. Olave sports a 59-774-2 line on 87 targets through nine games, and he'll look to bounce back in a Week 11 tilt against the Bears.

injury.comment: Collins secured nine of 16 targets for 94 yards and a touchdown in the Texans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Collins comfortably paced the Texans across the board in receptions, receiving yards and targets, and he added his fifth touchdown of the season on a 12-yard catch in the first quarter. Collins also had a 16-yard reception on Houston's last-gasp drive wiped out by an offensive holding penalty, but he still finished with season highs in receptions and targets. Collins retains an unquestioned No. 1 role in the Texans' prolific air attack, affording him an enticing combination of floor and upside heading into a favorable Week 11 home matchup against the Colts on Thursday night.

injury.comment: Jefferson caught nine of 13 targets for 74 yards in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers.
injury.longComment: In Kirk Cousins' return to the Vikings, Jefferson led the team in catches, targets and receiving yards, although Myles Price and Gavin Bartholomew were on the other end of the QB's two touchdown passes. The nine grabs and 13 targets were season highs for Jefferson, while the yardage total was his best showing since Week 5. Despite a disappointing 40-467-4 line on 64 targets through eight games, the star wideout's outlook for the rest of the year is pointed up heading into a Week 11 clash with the 49ers.

injury.comment: McMillan caught three of seven targets for 35 yards in Sunday's 20-17 win over New Orleans.
injury.longComment: The seven targets led the Panthers on the afternoon, but the second-year wideout wasn't able to do much with them. The 35 yards were McMillan's lowest total since Week 3, and he'll take a 49-660-3 line on 78 targets through nine games into a Week 11 tilt against the Ravens.

injury.comment: Lawrence completed 25 of 35 passes for 352 yards and three touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans. He added 27 yards on four carries.
injury.longComment: It was another huge performance from the 27-year-old QB, as Lawrence set a new season high in passing yards and threw at least three TDs for the fifth time in nine games to begin the year. He spread the ball around again, as seven different Jaguars caught multiple passes and Parker Washington, Josh Cameron and Brenton Strange were all on the other end of scores. Lawrence will take a sharp 21:5 TD:INT into a Week 11 clash with the Giants.

injury.comment: Tuten carried the ball 26 times for 88 yards and a touchdown and caught three of four targets for 25 yards in Sunday's 40-23 win over Tennessee.
injury.longComment: It's the second time this season that Tuten has reached triple-digit scrimmage yards in a game, with both those performances coming since the Jaguars' Week 7 bye. The second-year RB capped the rout with a six-yard TD run in the fourth quarter, extending his scoring streak to four games -- a stretch in which Tuten has racked up 260 rushing yards and three touchdowns on the ground while adding a 9-128-3 line on 10 targets through the air. He'll look to keep rolling in Week 11 against the Giants.

injury.comment: London is being evaluated for a possible concussion during Sunday's game against the Chiefs, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.
injury.longComment: Before his departure late in the fourth quarter, London recorded six catches (on 12 targets) for 109 yards. If he's diagnosed with a concussion, he'll be subject to league protocol in order to gain clearance to play again, but the Falcons are on bye in Week 11, so he'll have plenty of time to recover for a Week 12 road matchup with the Vikings on Sunday, Nov. 29.

injury.comment: Love completed 17 of 27 passes for 220 yards and a touchdown with an interception in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.
injury.longComment: The 28-year-old QB came into the game having been sacked just 17 times in his first nine games of the season, but Minnesota brought Love down eight times Sunday. Despite that onslaught, he was able to find J. Michael Sturdivant for a 32-yard TD in the third quarter to salvage his line slightly. It was the first time since Week 6 that Love had failed to throw multiple touchdowns, and just the second time all season. He'll get a Week 11 bye to heal up from Sunday's pummeling before facing Myles Garrett and the Rams in Week 12.

injury.comment: Wilson (concussion) caught seven of 14 targets for 106 yards and lost a fumble in Sunday's 31-12 loss to the Bills.
injury.longComment: Wilson set a new season high in targets and came one yard short of his Week 3 season high Sunday in his return from a one-game absence due to a concussion. His production came on a mix of passes from Geno Smith (ankle) and rookie Cade Klubnik, the latter of whom saw his first NFL action after Smith exited in the second half. Wilson figures to work as the top target for whomever starts under center in a Week 11 road game against the Chargers.

injury.comment: Kittle brought in six of nine targets for 74 yards in the 49ers' 46-40 win over the Cowboys on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Kittle put together a very solid fantasy performance that was easily lost in the shuffle of multiple spectacular efforts by players on either side. However, the veteran tight end did pace the 49ers in receptions and targets while finishing second in receiving yards, and he's now recorded at least 70 yards on five occasions this season. Kittle is up to a 44-557-5 line on 62 targets through nine games as a Week 11 home showdown against the Vikings next Sunday night approaches.

injury.comment: Prescott completed 30 of 51 passes for 343 yards with five touchdowns and one interception while rushing four times for seven yards in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers on Sunday. He also ran for a two-point conversion.
injury.longComment: Playing catch-up from the second quarter on did wonders for Prescott's fantasy production, as the veteran quarterback sent 38 total targets in the direction of the talented trio of George Pickens, CeeDee Lamb and Ryan Flournoy alone. Prescott connected with Pickens for three of his scoring strikes, which went for 35, 39 and five yards. Flournoy (11 yards) and Lamb (one yard) accounted for the final two in the fourth quarter, and Prescott added a two-point conversion run after the final scoring toss with an admirable diving attempt on which he made contact with the pylon with the extended ball. Prescott tied a career high with his TD pass total, while his passing yardage was a season high. He should have an opportunity to put together a successful encore next Sunday, as a Week 11 home matchup with the vulnerable Titans secondary awaits.

injury.comment: Pickens brought in 11 of 18 targets for 145 yards and three touchdowns in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers on Sunday.
injury.longComment: After watching fellow wideout CeeDee Lamb have several monster performances through the first half of the season, Pickens stepped up and took his turn in his return from a one-game absence due to a hamstring injury. Pickens was peppered with targets from Dak Prescott all afternoon, and the star receiver finished with career-high reception and target totals and a season high in receiving yards. A now clearly healthy Pickens is up to a 50-678-5 line on 80 targets for the season heading into a Week 11 home matchup against the Titans next Sunday.

injury.comment: Stafford completed 18 of 26 passes for 249 yards with three touchdowns and one interception and rushed twice for minus-2 yards in the Rams' 34-6 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Stafford didn't let the fact he was without top wideouts Puka Nacua (IR, knee/toe) and Davante Adams (IR, hamstring) deter him from a very fantasy-friendly performance, as the reigning NFL MVP tossed at least three TD passes for the fourth time this season. Stafford connected with the unlikely trio of Tyler Higbee (five yards), Xavier Smith (22 yards) and Davis Allen (19 yards) for his scoring strikes, and the quarterback's 9.6 yards per attempt was his second-highest figure of the season. Stafford, who'll have a chance to further build chemistry with his current wideouts during the Week 11 bye, could have Adams back for a Week 12 Thanksgiving Eve matchup against the Packers on Nov. 25, as reports earlier Sunday indicated the talented wideout is targeting that game for his return.

injury.comment: Washington caught seven of nine targets for 152 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans.
injury.longComment: The 152 receiving yards were a new career high for Washington, and the fourth-year WR highlighted his big day with a two-yard TD toss from Trevor Lawrence in the first quarter to open the scoring. It's Washington's second game this season with 100-plus yards, and he'll take a 36-645-6 line on 64 targets through nine contests into a Week 11 tilt against the Giants.

injury.comment: Rice brought in five of six targets for 82 yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Rice led the Chiefs in receiving yards and finished second in receptions and targets on a prolific afternoon for the Chiefs' air attack. Rice didn't get in on the scoring fun of a five-touchdown day for Patrick Mahomes, but he still eclipsed 80 receiving yards for the third time this season and first time since Week 3. Rice's level of involvement was encouraging given the debuting Josh Downs drew five targets, keeping the former's prospects bright for a favorable Week 11 home matchup against the Cardinals next Sunday.

injury.comment: Mahomes completed 22 of 35 passes for 348 yards with five touchdowns and no interceptions while adding two rushes for 15 yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Taking advantage of a controlled environment and a fast track at Mercedes-Benz Stadium -- not to mention the presence of the debuting Josh Downs -- Mahomes repeatedly exploited the vulnerabilities of the Falcons defense throughout the afternoon. The legendary signal-caller showed no ill effects from the elbow injury that he'd suffered in Week 9, and he connected with Emmett Johnson (12, six yards), Downs (18 yards), Cyrus Allen (39 yards) and Andrew Armstrong (43 yards) for his quintet of touchdown passes. Mahomes now has multiple scoring strikes and zero interceptions in three straight games, and Sunday's five TD tosses represented a new season high. Mahomes will take 2,385 passing yards and a 19:4 TD:INT into a Week 11 home matchup against the Cardinals next Sunday.

injury.comment: Pollard carried the ball nine times for 33 yards and caught eight of nine targets for 66 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars.
injury.longComment: The veteran RB fell one yard short of reaching 100 scrimmage yards for a third straight game, and Pollard gave the Titans a brief glimmer of hope in the fourth quarter when he took a checkdown from Cam Ward 32 yards to the house, making the score 30-23. Pollard led the Titans in receptions as he produced season-best numbers through the air, and he could retain elevated usage as a pass catcher if top WRs Carnell Tate (shoulder) and Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) miss additional time. Pollard lines up for a potential revenge game in Week 11 against the Cowboys.

injury.comment: Evans (Achilles) has a chance to return to action next Sunday against the Vikings, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.
injury.longComment: Evans is missing his third consecutive game this Sunday in Dallas due to right Achilles tendinitis that he suffered during a Week 6 win versus the Commanders. He hasn't practiced in the meantime, and while he's a rare player who doesn't need on-field reps during the week to be available on game days, he would provide confidence in his ability to play again with an appearance in drills at some point this Wednesday through Friday.

tg.callText: [strong] He hasn't practiced since leaving Week 6 with Achilles tendinitis, he has already missed two games, and on Wed Nov 11, 2026 Shanahan said he is "week-to-week" (SF Chronicle: "unlikely to play Sunday against Dallas").

injury.comment: Stroud completed 20 of 38 passes for 211 yards with three touchdowns and one interception while adding three rushes for 20 yards in the Texans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Stroud looked like he was on his way to another highly productive day early while helping stake the Texans to a 17-0 lead in the first half, but the fourth-year signal-caller and his offense largely stagnated in the second half. Stroud spread the ball around while connecting with eight different targets overall, and his trio of scoring strikes went to Nico Collins (12 yards), Xavier Hutchinson (11 yards) and Dalton Schultz (11 yards), the latter accounting for Houston's only second-half points. Despite the Texans' monumental collapse, Stroud's highly impressive season continues, as he's up to 2,462 passing yards, a 19:3 TD:INT and 120 rushing yards and another score heading into a favorable Week 11 home matchup against the Colts on Thursday night.

injury.comment: Hall rushed 11 times for 41 yards and caught all four of his targets for 67 yards in Sunday's 31-12 loss to the Bills.
injury.longComment: Hall narrowly topped Braelon Allen (eight carries for 40 yards) for the team lead in rushing yards and finished second behind Garrett Wilson (seven catches for 106 yards) in both receptions and receiving yards. While Allen continues to be more efficient as a rusher, Hall's superior receiving ability should help the latter maintain the edge in playing time for a 2-8 Jets team that often finds itself playing catch-up. Rookie QB Cade Klubnik, who played most of the second half Sunday, could be more reliant on check downs to Hall than veteran Geno Smith (ankle) was, but it remains to be seen who will get the nod under center in Week 11 against the Chargers.

injury.comment: Young completed 17 of 30 passes for 200 yards without a touchdown or interception in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Saints. He added one rushing yard on his only carry.
injury.longComment: Chuba Hubbard did most of the heavy lifting on offense for the Panthers, piling up 172 scrimmage yards and both the team's touchdowns. It's the first time this season Young failed to throw a TD, but it was also the first time since Week 6 he avoided committing a turnover. The fourth-year QB will take a 16:6 TD:INT through nine games into a Week 11 clash against the Ravens.

injury.comment: Gordon rushed 20 times for 76 and brought in four of five targets for 39 yards in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Filling his customary workhorse role in Miami's ground attack, Gordon handled all but four of the Dolphins' running back carries while finishing with a team-high reception total. The second-year back eclipsed 75 rushing yards for the fourth time in six games in the process, and Gordon's catch and receiving yardage totals were also season highs. Gordon should remain in a high-volume role in a Week 11 road matchup against the Bills next Sunday.

injury.comment: Moore caught four of six targets for 90 yards and a touchdown while rushing once for four yards in Sunday's 31-12 win over the Jets.
injury.longComment: Moore's 45-yard touchdown catch in the third quarter accounted for half of his team-high total in receiving yards. This was his most productive outing since Moore went for 100 yards and a TD in his Bills debut, and the veteran wide receiver has chipped in 216 scrimmage yards and two touchdowns in three games since returning from a shoulder injury. Josh Allen and James Cook continue to lead Buffalo's offense with their legs, but Moore has re-established himself as Allen's top target in the passing game heading into a Week 11 home game against the Dolphins.

injury.comment: Coach DeMeco Ryans acknowledged after Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns that Marks (concussion) is unlikely to play in Thursday night's game against the Colts, ESPN.com's DJ Bien-Aime reports.
injury.longComment: With the Texans on a short week ahead of the contest, Ryans noted of Marks, "Just not enough time for him to turn it around that quickly." As for the Week 11 status of fellow RB David Montgomery (groin) -- who was inactive again Sunday -- Ryans said, "I'm not certain if David can play or not," adding "We'll take it one day at a time to see how he feels and how he can get back." Prior to his exit Sunday, Marks had 12 carries for 50 yards and one catch for 15 yards. Meanwhile, Emari Demercado finished with seven carries for 16 yards and one catch for minus-one yard, while Dare Ogunbowale logged one carry for two yards and one catch for 13 yards.

injury.comment: Coker failed to catch any of his four targets in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Saints.
injury.longComment: While it looked like Coker was going to be in line for a breakout 2026 season after his 8-138-2 receiving performance in the Week 1 opener, Coker has been held to 23 catches for 255 yards and one touchdown over his last seven games. At this point, he can't be trusted in fantasy lineups until he shows something in the box score again. This was a pristine on-paper spot versus New Orleans in the dome, and next Sunday's home date against Baltimore won't be any easier.

injury.comment: Shough completed 25 of 35 targets for 187 yards and one touchdown with one interception in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Panthers. He added 25 rushing yards on six carries and was charged with a lost fumble.
injury.longComment: The second-year QB had more turnovers than TDs for only the second time this season, although his fumble may have been been more Audric Estime's fault, and Shough fell short of 200 passing yards for the third time. Rookie Jordyn Tyson was his top downfield option, catching 11 of 13 targets for 80 yards in a breakout performance, but no other Saint saw more than five targets or hauled in more than three passes. Shough will take a 15:7 TD:INT into a Week 11 clash with the Bears.

injury.comment: Charbonnet churned out 94 yards on 20 carries during Sunday's 21-13 win in Las Vegas.
injury.longComment: Charbonnet was eased in to the mix in Weeks 8 and 9, going from nine touches in the first contest to 17 in the latter. This time around, though, he doubled up fellow RB Jadarian Price in touches (10) and more than did so in terms from yards from scrimmage (44). It may signal that Charbonnet is the Seahawks' clear-cut No. 1 backfield option moving forward, but he won't have a chance to prove as much until after the team's Week 11 bye on Sunday, Nov. 29, at San Francisco.

injury.comment: Jones carried the ball 11 times for 47 yards and a touchdown and caught his only target for eight yards in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers.
injury.longComment: Jordan Mason led the Vikings with 59 rushing yards, but Jones had the more productive afternoon as he scored his first TD since Week 5 on a one-yard plunge in the second quarter. Jones' upside will remain limited while working in a timeshare with Mason, but he's still got some utility heading into a Week 11 clash with the 49ers.

injury.comment: inactive

injury.comment: Judkins rushed 10 times for 38 yards and a touchdown and brought in three of five targets for 33 yards in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Texans on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Judkins' rushing volume was at a season-low level, but the second-year back managed to record his fourth rushing touchdown of the campaign on a five-yard run with just under a minute remaining. That proved to be the game-winning score, and Judkins also mustered his second-highest receiving yardage tally of the campaign. The 2025 first-round pick is averaging just 3.4 yards per carry, however, so he remains far from efficient heading into a Week 11 bye ahead of a Week 12 home matchup against the Raiders on Sunday, Nov. 29.

injury.comment: Etienne carried the ball eight times for 14 yards and caught three of five targets for 20 yards in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Panthers.
injury.longComment: Seeing his first action since Week 3 after recovering from a hamstring strain, the former Jaguar led the Saints' backfield with 11 touches, ahead of Audric Estime's eight and Alvin Kamara's five. Etienne wasn't able to do much with the volume, however, while Kamara scored two short TDs. Etienne still appears to be the top option for the team at RB, but if Estime keeps taking short-yardage work and Kamara is the preferred red-zone back, it would put a real ceiling on Etienne's upside. He'll look to claim a bigger share of the workload in Week 11 against the Bears.

tg.callText: [strong] The Saints activated him from injured reserve on Saturday, Nov 14, and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported he is expected to play, after he practiced Wednesday through Friday (sources disagree on whether Friday was full or limited).

injury.comment: Samuel rushed three times for 78 yards and a touchdown and brought in all three targets for 31 yards and another score in the 49ers' 46-40 win over the Cowboys on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Samuel made his return from a three-game absence due to a hamstring injury, and the versatile veteran was put right to work as the de facto No. 1 receiver with Mike Evans (Achilles) still sidelined. Samuel came just a yard short of tying his single-game career high in rushing yards, and his receiving and rushing touchdowns came from 11 and 70 yards out, respectively. Samuel has five total touchdowns through six games heading into a Week 11 home matchup against a tough Vikings defense next Sunday night.

injury.comment: The Vikings are hopeful that Murray (hamstring) will be available to play Week 12 against the Falcons, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.
injury.longComment: Murray is on the mend from a Grade 2 hamstring injury, which he sustained during the Vikings' Week 8 loss to the Lions. The Vikings acquired Kirk Cousins from the Raiders on Tuesday, and the veteran quarterback will take over as the team's new starter beginning with Sunday's game at Green Bay, with Carson Wentz and Max Brosmer working as the reserve options behind him. Once he overcomes the hamstring injury, Murray will look to wrest the No. 2 job away from Wentz.

tg.callText: [strong] His hamstring kept him out of Wednesday's (Nov 11) estimated practice, Rotoworld says the Grade 2 strain means he'll miss multiple games, and he's listed Doubtful.

injury.comment: Jeanty turned his nine carries into just 18 yards and caught all four of his targets for 46 yards during Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Seahawks.
injury.longComment: After reaching the 10-carry threshold in each of the first six games of the season, Jeanty has failed to do so in four straight contests, and he also has fallen shy of 30 rushing yards in six consecutive outings. Rookie RB Mike Washington continued to split the backfield with Jeanty in Week 10, turning his nine touches into 27 yards from scrimmage. Considering recent trends, Jeanty is difficult to trust for consistent production without a boost in work.

injury.comment: Allen rushed eight times for 40 yards and caught his only target for six yards in Sunday's 31-12 loss to the Bills.
injury.longComment: For a second consecutive game, Allen was outplayed by Breece Hall, who produced 108 scrimmage yards on 15 touches. Allen remains the more efficient runner, averaging 5.0 yards per carry to Hall's 3.4 this season, but Hall is the team's preferred option in passing situations, which have been plentiful with the 2-8 Jets frequently in catch-up mode. Perhaps a Week 11 matchup with a Chargers team that's still searching for its first win through Sunday of Week 10 will offer an opportunity to stick with the run and play to Allen's strengths.

injury.comment: Cooper (ankle) won't return to Sunday's game against the Bills, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.
injury.longComment: After being deemed questionable to return to the contest earlier Sunday, Cooper has now been ruled out and will target a potential return to action Nov. 22 against the Chargers. In his absence versus Buffalo, Garrett Wilson, Adonai Mitchell and Isaiah Williams are available lead New York's WR corps.

tg.callText: [strong] Cooper (ankle) was limited Wednesday and Thursday, practiced fully Friday (Nov 13) and is listed questionable; Matt Zenitz (CBS, Nov 14) reports he's expected to be available.

injury.comment: Cousins completed 21 of 31 passes for 207 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers. He added 11 rushing yards on three carries.
injury.longComment: Brought back to Minnesota at the trade deadline to stabilize the offense, Cousins did exactly that, connecting with Myles Price for a 38-yard TD in the first quarter and Gavin Bartholomew on a 20-yard score in the fourth while guiding Justin Jefferson to season highs in catches and targets. The Vikings' passing game didn't need to over-extend itself, however, as the defense sacked Jordan Love eight times in another dominant performance. Cousins may need to find another gear in Week 11 against the 49ers, but he'll have another week of practice to re-familiarize himself with Kevin O'Connell's scheme first.

injury.comment: McGowan rushed 12 times for 77 yards and a touchdown and returned two kickoffs for 61 yards in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
injury.longComment: The rookie had shown well in recent weeks while trade speculation swirled around Jonathan Taylor, and even though the latter ultimately stayed put at the deadline, McGowan still compiled a new career high in rush attempts and rushing yards. The Kentucky product also followed up his first career rushing touchdown in Week 9 against the Cowboys with a four-yard scoring run early in the second quarter Sunday, and McGowan was also productive in his returner role. While Taylor should remain the de facto top backfield option for the Colts, McGowan should remain in an elevated role for what remains of Indianapolis' non-contending season.

injury.comment: Mason carried the ball 16 times for 59 yards and failed to catch his only target in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers.
injury.longComment: The fifth-year RB led the Vikings in rushing yards, but Aaron Jones was the more productive player in the backfield, gaining 55 scrimmage yards on 12 touches and scoring on a one-yard plunge in the second quarter. Mason has yet to get into the end zone in four games since returning from a thumb injury, piecing together 182 rushing yards on 4.0 yards per carry while working in a timeshare with Jones. He could break that drought in Week 11 in a potential revenge game against the 49ers.

injury.comment: Shakir caught two of three targets for 26 yards in Sunday's 31-12 win over the Jets.
injury.longComment: With Buffalo controlling this one most of the afternoon, Josh Allen attempted just 21 passes and completed only 11 on a day wind gusts played a factor. Shakir's 26 receiving yards were his fewest since Week 3. He's scored just one touchdown this season and has yet to hit 100 yards in a game all year, so the ceiling isn't that high for fantasy while the floor is what he produced Sunday. Shakir is more of fantasy WR4 in PPR-based formats.

injury.comment: Flournoy tallied six catches for 71 yards and one touchdown on seven targets during Sunday's loss to San Francisco. He also recovered a fumble.
injury.longComment: Dallas played catch-up for much of the second half in the offensive slugfest, so quarterback Dak Prescott took to the air 51 times. Flournoy got seven of those targets, finishing third on the team behind George Pickens (18) and CeeDee Lamb (13). Flournoy's six receptions and 71 yards were both his second-most so far this season, and the TD was his third in the past five weeks. That last stat in particular gives him relevance in most fantasy leagues, especially in matchups during which Prescott is expected to air it out often. The Cowboys will seek a much-needed win next Sunday at home against Tennessee.

injury.comment: The Dolphins hope Willis (abdomen) will return this year but haven't ruled out season-ending surgery, Joe Schad of The Palm Beach Post reports.
injury.longComment: With that in mind, coach Jeff Hafley noted that Willis had an MRI to assess his core muscle injury and will continue to explore medical opinions. The team already placed Willis on injured reserve, ruling him out through Week 13. The latest report suggests that it's still unclear whether Willis will miss four games, the rest of the season or something in between. Kyle McCord is taking over at QB for the Dolphins in the meantime, with Hafley on Wednesday noting of Willis' job security in general, "He'll be the starting quarterback if he returns."

injury.comment: Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans said Sunday that he's "not certain" if Montgomery (groin) will be able to play Thursday against Indianapolis, DJ Bien-Aime of ESPN reports.
injury.longComment: Montgomery hasn't suited up since he suffered a groin injury Week 5 in Tennessee. However, he practiced in full this past Friday for the first time since getting hurt, and the Texans described his work during Week 10 prep as a "ramp-up" ahead of potentially returning Week 11. Ryans didn't sound certain after Sunday's loss to Cleveland that Montgomery will be able to play versus the Colts, but if the veteran running back does suit up, it could be a huge boost to a Houston offense that may be without the RB who has been filling in as the starter for Montgomery. Woody Marks suffered a concussion Sunday and isn't likely to be cleared in time to play Thursday.

injury.comment: Allgeier mustered five carries for 14 yards and didn't gather in his only target during Sunday's 34-6 defeat to the Rams.
injury.longComment: With Bam Knight back in the lineup in Week 10 after one absence due to a concussion, Allgeier didn't reach double-digit touches for the first time since Week 5, a span in which the latter's 65 touches went for 334 yards from scrimmage and two total TDs. Knight himself found a similar lack of success Sunday with just 19 yards on his five rushes. Because the Cardinals racked up just 123 yards of offense in rookie QB Carson Beck's first NFL start, it's tough to envision worse outcomes moving forward, though the team does take on the surging Chiefs next Sunday on the road.

injury.comment: Boston caught just one pass for 16 yards on two targets in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
injury.longComment: The rookie wideout entered play Sunday dealing with a toe injury and appeared to aggravate it versus Houston. At less than 100 percent health, Boston was unproductive in the box score and saw a microscopic five percent target share. After popping back up for 6-98-0 receiving last Sunday in New Orleans with Shedeur Sanders at quarterback, Boston reverted to his sluggish ways with Deshaun Watson in Week 10. Over his last four games with Watson, Boston has compiled 11 catches for 95 empty yards. Boston can't be trusted in fantasy lineups until he shows more consistency.

injury.comment: Watson completed 25 of 40 passes for 312 yards with no touchdowns and one interception while adding eight rushes for 49 yards and a score in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Texans on Sunday. He also committed a fumble that remained with Cleveland.
injury.longComment: Watson helped the Browns overcome a 17-point first-half deficit, even though he didn't throw any touchdown passes for the fourth straight game. The veteran signal-caller did pile up the passing yardage against his old team, however, eclipsing 300 yards for the third straight game in the process. Watson also hit Harold Fannin with a critical 30-yard pass on his last pass attempt of the afternoon to set up Quinshon Judkins' game-winning rushing touchdown, and he'll next draw a highly favorable matchup against the Raiders in a Week 12 home matchup on Sunday, Nov. 29, following a Week 11 bye.

injury.comment: Corum rushed 17 times for 100 yards and a touchdown and brought in three of four targets for 19 yards in the Rams' 34-6 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Corum was far more productive than backfield mate Kyren Williams, who he outpaced by five carries and 77 rushing yards. It was the fourth straight game with double-digit rush attempts and a touchdown for Corum, with Sunday's score coming from one yard out early in the third quarter. He has at least 73 rushing yards in three of the last four contests, and it remains to be seen if Sunday's division of labor will have any sticking power when Los Angeles returns to action following a Week 11 bye in a Week 12 home Thanksgiving Eve matchup against the Packers on Nov. 25.

injury.comment: Price posted nine carries for 36 yards and one touchdown and gathered in his only target for eight yards during Sunday's 21-13 victory at Las Vegas.
injury.longComment: This marks Price's fewest touches in a game since returning from IR in Week 8, and he actually was doubled up in the category by position mate Zach Charbonnet, who turned his 20 rushes into 94 yards. Having said that, Price salvaged his day with a 12-yard TD, the first of his career, on the ground in the third quarter. The breakdown of work between the two may signal what's to come in the Seahawks backfield after the team's Week 11 bye, with Price and company set to face off with the NFC West-leading 49ers on the road on Sunday, Nov. 29.

injury.comment: Rodriguez rushed for five yards on four carries in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans.
injury.longComment: Rodriguez was out-carried 26 to four by Bhayshul Tuten, who has very much proven himself as the Jaguars' clear RB1 in one of the league's best offenses. Tuten also out-snapped Rodriguez 52 to 10, while LeQuint Allen (12 snaps) saw more playing time. Rodriguez is little more than a deep-league bench stash should something happen to Tuten.

injury.comment: Allen brought in five of seven targets for 61 yards in the 49ers' 46-40 win over the Cowboys on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Allen looked rejuvenated in his 49ers debut after coming over from the Colts at the deadline, finishing third in receptions and receiving yards and second in targets for his new squad in the wild win. Allen and Brock Purdy seemed to have instant chemistry despite having practiced on only three occasions coming into the contest, and the veteran receiver's production should have a good chance of spiking further down the stretch of the regular season.

injury.comment: Tucker caught one pass for nine yards on two targets in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Seahawks.
injury.longComment: In Fernando Mendoza's first career start at quarterback, Tucker saw just 6.9 percent of the targets, while Jack Bech led the team with seven looks. Tucker looks like someone who won't be usable in fantasy until he shows some tangible chemistry with the young quarterback.

injury.comment: Kincaid caught two of three targets for 58 yards in Sunday's 31-12 win over the Jets.
injury.longComment: Kincaid contributed catches of four and 54 yards to finish second on the team in receiving yards behind DJ Moore (90). The 2023 first-round pick has seen his usage fluctuate throughout the campaign, as Kincaid has failed to exceed three targets on five occasions but has drawn at least six looks from Josh Allen in each of the other four games. Kincaid is making the most of his opportunities for a second consecutive regular season, averaging 11.9 yards per target in 2026 after leading all qualified TEs with 11.7 YPT in 2025. Next up for Kincaid is a Week 11 home game against the Dolphins.

injury.comment: Lock completed 14 of 17 passes for 240 yards, two touchdowns and no interceptions and logged six carries for 20 yards during Sunday's 21-13 victory in Las Vegas.
injury.longComment: Lock took advantage of having WR Jaxon Smith-Njigba at his disposal, targeting him 10 times, one of which resulted in a 71-yard TD connection. Moreover, Lock also hooked up with Cooper Kupp on a sliding 34-yard touchdown, marking his second multi-TD outing in four appearances (three starts) this season. There's an expectation that Seahawks No. 1 QB Sam Darnold (quadriceps) returns from a two-game absence after the team's Week 11 bye, but until he receives a clean bill of health, Lock has a chance to be under center on the road against the 49ers on Sunday, Nov. 29.

injury.comment: Black rushed 11 times for 53 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 46-40 win over the Cowboys. He added two catches for 13 yards on two targets.
injury.longComment: The rookie running back has tallied double-digit carries in three straight games and played 26 of 65 offensive snaps behind Christian McCaffrey's 39 snaps. CMC was also extremely productive out of the backfield against Dallas' Swiss-cheese defense, turning 17 touches into 243 total yards and three touchdowns. Black is more involved than most of McCaffrey's backups have been in recent seasons, and the rookie is offering some standalone RB2/3 valuation in one of the league's most efficient offenses. Over the last three games, Black has rushed 34 times for 186 yards (5.5 YPC) and two touchdowns.

injury.comment: Sampson rushed four times for six yards and caught four of six targets for 31 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
injury.longComment: Sampson hardly carries the ball for Cleveland and is merely the pass-catching complement to Quinshon Judkins out of the backfield. Across five games this season, Sampson has rushed 19 times for 79  yards while adding 16 catches for 152 yards on 22 targets. He's playable in PPR fantasy leagues as a desperation RB2 option, particularly in games for which the Browns are projected to play from behind.

injury.comment: Kamra rushed two times for four yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Panthers. He added three catches for 10 yards and an additional touchdown on four targets.
injury.longComment: With Travis Etienne back from his weeks-long hamstring injury that saw him miss five games while on injured reserve, the Saints deployed a three-man backfield committee against Carolina. Kamara scored a couple touchdowns, but it was a fluky performance on just five touches and 16 offensive snaps. Audric Estime logged 27 snaps and handled eight touches, while Etienne played 21 snaps and touched the ball 11 times. This is a backfield to avoid in fantasy while it the trio cancels each other out and caps each others' upside.

injury.comment: When asked Wednesday whether Pierce (heel) has a chance to return from IR this season, Colts head coach Shane Steichen was noncommittal, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.
injury.longComment: "We'll see. Like I said last week, he's still in that rehab process, and I'm not going to put a timetable on return," Steichen noted of the wideout, who's been on IR since Sept. 26. At 2-7, the Colts were sellers ahead of the NFL's trade deadline, so the team presumably has no reason rush Pierce back. With Keenan Allen and Josh Downs no longer in the mix, Indy's healthy WRs for now are Ashton Dulin, Laquon Treadwell, Anthony Gould, Deion Burks and Nick Westbrook-Ikhine.

injury.comment: Tyson caught 11 of 13 targets for 80 yards in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Panthers.
injury.longComment: That bang you just heard was the sound of the window closing on your chances of acquiring Tyson cheaply in your fantasy league. In just his second career NFL game, Tyson dominated looks from Tyler Shough, as no other New Orleans pass catcher handled more than five targets, hauled in more than three passes or topped 30 receiving yards. It may be tough for the team's struggling offense to keep both Tyson and Chris Olave busy at the same time, so the duo may end up trading big games rather than opening things up for each other, but this kind of volume can't be ignored. Tyson will look for his first career touchdown in a Week 11 tilt against the Bears.

injury.comment: Kraft caught one of four targets for 19 yards in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.
injury.longComment: The tight end's numbers reflected how much time his quarterback had to look downfield, as Jordan Love got sacked eight times in the rout. Kraft has been held to just one catch in back-to-back games, and he heads into a Week 11 bye with a 37-370-3 line on 56 targets through 10 games, with the Rams as the next opponent on the horizon in Week 12.

injury.comment: Penix completed 23 of 43 passes for 286 yards with no touchdowns and one interception and rushed four times for 29 yards in the Falcons' 35-13 loss to the Chiefs on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.
injury.longComment: Penix struggled while the game was still in question, but he did manage to pad his stats some down the stretch as the Falcons unsuccessfully tried to overcome their deficit. Penix connected with eight different targets overall on the afternoon, and he ultimately finished with a season high in passing yards. Penix has now tossed six interceptions in the last three games, however, and he'll look to regroup during the Week 11 bye before tackling a difficult matchup against the Vikings on the road on Sunday, Nov. 29.

injury.comment: Jones completed 11 of 22 passes for 108 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions while adding five carries for nine yards in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.
injury.longComment: Jones failed to eclipse the 200-yard mark for the fourth straight game while throwing multiple picks for the second time in that span. Neither turnover led to any Dolphins points, and Jones also threw a seven-yard touchdown pass to new interim No. 1 receiver Laquon Treadwell in the second quarter. Jones has completed just 59.6 percent of his passes and has a 7:12 TD:INT across 10 games, and with Indianapolis devoid of any realistic postseason aspirations, it may not be long before Anthony Richardson is given an opportunity under center. However, Joel A. Erickson of The Indy Star reports that head coach Shane Steichen has already named Jones the starter for Thursday's Week 11 road matchup against the Texans.

injury.comment: Washington compiled eight rushes for 23 yards and secured his only target for four yards during Sunday's 21-13 defeat to the Seahawks.
injury.longComment: Aside from a 25-carry outburst in Week 8 at the Jets, Washington has logged 54 rushes along with four catches in nine appearances, which amounts to 6.4 touches per game. Despite that number, he continues to eat into the overall backfield picture, as lead runner Ashton Jeanty failed to tally double-digit rushes for a fourth straight contest Sunday. Washington should retain a modest role alongside Jeanty next Sunday at Denver.

injury.comment: Mitchell caught three passes for 59 yards on eight targets in Sunday's 31-12 loss to the Bills.
injury.longComment: With Garrett Wilson back from his one-game absence Sunday, Mitchell was left fighting for secondary looks. His eight targets were second on the team, trailing Wilson's 14, and Omar Cooper's early-game ankle injury helped Mitchell's volume solidify. If Cooper is going to miss time going forward, Mitchell will be a more comfortable fantasy WR3 play with upside headed into next Sunday's game against the Chargers.

tg.callText: [strong] Mitchell's knee was added to the report Friday, but he practiced fully that day (Nov 13), and Matt Zenitz (CBS, Nov 14) reports he's expected to play.

injury.comment: Fannin brought in seven of nine targets for 91 yards in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Texans on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Fannin led the Browns across the board in receptions, receiving yards and targets, and his 30-yard grab on Cleveland's penultimate possession set up Quinshon Judkins' game-winning five-yard touchdown rush on the next play. Fannin's chemistry with Deshaun Watson has been outstanding, and the second-year tight end now has at least 91 receiving yards in three of the past four games. Fannin will remain a central figure in Cleveland's impressive air attack when the team returns to action in a home matchup against the Raiders on Sunday, Nov. 29, following a Week 11 bye.

tg.callText: [strong] He was limited Wednesday (Nov 11, Mary Kay Cabot) with the same groin injury that limited him in practice on Nov 5. He still played in the last game (2 catches, 42 yards, 1 TD), so this looks like an injury he's managing rather than one keeping him out.

injury.comment: Ward completed 28 of 39 passes for 231 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars.
injury.longComment: The second-year QB kept his team in the game for three quarters, and Ward connected with Tony Pollard for a 32-yard catch-and-run TD on a checkdown in the fourth quarter that brought the Titans to within one score, only for the Jags to pull away late. Ward's production is slowly creeping up, and he's thrown for 535 yards over the last two games with a 4:1 TD:INT, 68.4 percent completion rate and 6.8 YPA, numbers which represent a big step up from the beginning of the season. He'll look to keep making progress in his development in Week 11 against a vulnerable Cowboys defense.

injury.comment: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said after Sunday's loss to Buffalo that Smith, who departed the contest due to an ankle injury, will have his status for Week 11 determined during the upcoming week of practice, Jack Bell of the Jets' official site reports.
injury.longComment: Smith was hurt during New York's final offensive series of the first half Sunday when he was hit by a pair of defenders while throwing an incomplete pass. He was placed in concussion protocol and passed, clearing the way for him to return to the game. However, Smith then exited again after hurting his ankle, and this time he was unable to return. The veteran quarterback's practice activity, if any, during Week 11 prep will likely determine if he's able to suit up next Sunday against the Chargers. If Smith can't play, rookie Cade Klubnik would likely start under center.

injury.comment: Lloyd finished Sunday's loss to Minnesota with 13 yards on four carries while catching all three of his targets for 26 yards.
injury.longComment: With Josh Jacobs (finger) sidelined, Green Bay turned to the trio of Lloyd, Kaleb Johnson and Chris Brooks in the backfield. Johnson led the team with 10 carries and 42 total yards despite not getting any targets. Meanwhile, Lloyd turned his seven touches into 39 yards, and Brooks tallied just three yards on his three touches. Green Bay is on bye during the coming week, but Jacobs may still miss the team's next game, which will take place Wednesday, Nov. 25, against the Rams. If that's the case, Lloyd will likely work as part of a shared backfield again, which isn't great for his fantasy outlook.

injury.comment: Concepcion caught three of eight targets for 21 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over Houston. He also gained six yards on one carry.
injury.longComment: Concepcion finished second on the Browns in targets behind tight end Harold Fannin, who had nine. However, whereas Fannin was able to turn his looks into seven receptions and 91 yards, Concepcion posted a much more modest 3-21-0 line. The rookie wideout departed to the medical tent during the first half of the game due to an undisclosed issue, but he was able to quickly return. Concepcion hasn't put up prolific numbers this season, but he does have at least three receptions in eight of his 10 appearances. Cleveland is on bye in Week 11, so Concepcion will next suit up Sunday, Nov. 29, against Las Vegas.

injury.comment: Addison (thumb) is inactive for Sunday's game at Green Bay, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.
injury.longComment: A late addition to the Week 10 injury report, Addison took a questionable tag into Sunday after sustaining the thumb injury during Friday's practice. After Addison went through a pregame workout, the Vikings opted to hold him out for Sunday's contest while the thumb issue was seemingly inhibiting him while catching the football. With Addison and top tight end T.J. Hockenson (wrist) both sidelined, trade-deadline pickup Kirk Cousins won't have many weapons to work with beyond No. 1 wideout Justin Jefferson in his first start for Minnesota since 2023.

injury.comment: Wentz (ankle) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game at Green Bay, but Kirk Cousins will be Minnesota's starting quarterback.
injury.longComment: Kyler Murray (hamstring) is out for another week but may eventually replace Wentz as the No. 2 quarterback. Wentz's miserable performance against the Bills last week likely was a factor in the Vikings trading for Cousins.

tg.callText: [lean] He was limited Wednesday (Nov 11) with an ankle injury and is Questionable, which is a PLAY by default; separately, Fox says Kirk Cousins seems likely to start, so Wentz may only be the backup.

injury.comment: Minshew suffered a torn UCL in his right throwing elbow last Sunday at Seattle and is slated to undergo season-ending surgery, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
injury.longComment: Minshew incredibly played through the injury in Week 9, logging all 53 offensive snaps and completing 21 of 30 passes for 166 yards, no touchdowns and no interceptions in his first start replacing the since-departed Jacoby Brissett. Schefter added that Minshew still is determining the timing of the procedure, but he plans on having it. With Minshew out for the rest of the campaign, rookie third-round pick Carson Beck is taking over under center for the Cardinals.

injury.comment: Johnson rushed 22 times for 101 yards and brought in six of seven targets for 70 yards and two touchdowns in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Drawing his first career start due to Kenneth Walker (groin) being sidelined, Johnson put on a pretty convincing impression of his star teammate. Not only did Johnson just get himself over the century mark in rushing yards, but he finished as the team leader in receptions and targets while checking in as the runner-up in receiving yards. Johnson struck from 12 and six yards out for his two receiving TDs, underscoring his considerable versatility. If Walker is unable to garner active status for next Sunday's Week 11 matchup against the Cardinals, the Chiefs' ground attack will remain in good hands with Johnson.

injury.comment: Knight (concussion) is cleared to play Sunday against the Rams, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.
injury.longComment: Knight figures to split backfield work with Tyler Allgeier, who played 96 percent of snaps last week when Knight was inactive for a 17-3 loss at Seattle. Knight suffered the concussion in Week 8, shortly after Jeremiyah Love injured his ankle -- an issue that sent the rookie to injured reserve not long after. Love is out for at least three more games, leaving Allgeier and Knight to split backfield work again.

tg.callText: [lean] On Wednesday, Nov 11, he was limited in practice wearing a non-contact jersey, his first time practicing since the Week 8 concussion, and he is still in the concussion protocol, which he has to clear before Sunday. Thursday's (Nov 12) practice report was not found: an upgrade to full or out of the n

injury.comment: Brooks (groin) has been downgraded from doubtful to out for Sunday's game against the Saints, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.
injury.longComment: Brooks ended Week 10 prep with back-to-back limited practices, but he was tagged as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Panthers. The third-year running back is not quite fully recovered from a groin injury that landed him on IR in late September, so his next chance to suit up is Week 11 against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 22. Trevor Etienne, AJ Dillon and Anthony Tyus will continue to operate in rotational backfield roles behind Chuba Hubbard while Brooks is sidelined.

injury.comment: Downs secured four of five targets for 53 yards and a touchdown, fumbled once but recovered and returned three punts for 10 yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Making his Chiefs debut following three days of practice after arriving via trade from the Colts on Tuesday, Downs looked right at home in the Patrick Mahomes-led offense. The young wideout fully capitalized on the upgrade he saw at quarterback, finishing third in receptions, receiving yards and targets right out of the gate and adding his second touchdown of the season on a difficult 18-yard catch just before halftime. Downs' immediate chemistry with Mahomes is highly welcome news for fantasy managers, and he'll aim to carry the momentum over into a favorable Week 11 home matchup against the Cardinals next Sunday.

injury.comment: Washington secured all three targets for 50 yards, threw a 34-yard touchdown on his one pass attempt and returned four punts for 36 yards in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Washington finished second in receiving yards for the Dolphins and also was partly responsible for the team's one score through the air, uncorking a well-thrown 34-yard strike to Jalen Tolbert on a trick play. Washington also continued to produce in his returner role, and he's now up to 812 all-purpose yards through nine games heading into a Week 11 road matchup against the Bills next Sunday.

injury.comment: Kelce secured both targets for 30 yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Kelce recorded a 23-yard catch on the Chiefs' first play from scrimmage, seemingly a harbinger of a productive day. However, the veteran tight end also suffered an ankle injury on the tackle, and although he was able to return to the game, he had only one more reception the rest of the way. Despite the modest numbers, Kelce managed to keep his season-long streak of games with multiple receptions going, and he's averaging a career-best 14.6  per catch heading into a Week 11 home matchup against the Cardinals next Sunday.

injury.comment: Mendoza completed 17 of 29 passes for 143 yards, no touchdowns and no interceptions and rushed six times for 22 yards and one TD during Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Seahawks.
injury.longComment: The Mendoza era in Las Vegas officially kicked off this week following the trade of veteran QB Kirk Cousins to the Vikings, and the rookie first overall pick unsurprisingly flashed at times while also stalling numerous drives by taking six sacks overall. On a positive note, Mendoza didn't turn the ball over, and he also recorded his first touchdown as a pro on a 10-yard run on the Raiders' opening offensive possession. He'll seek to build on the initial start of his career next Sunday at Denver.

injury.comment: Spears rushed four times for 28 yards in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars. He turned one catch into zero yards on one target.
injury.longComment: After missing the previous two games with a knee injury, Spears returned to play 16 offensive snaps. Tony Pollard (41 snaps) remains the clear-cut lead back on this cellar-dwelling Tennessee team. Spears has minimal fantasy appeal now that Pollard survived the trade deadline and will finish out the season with the Titans.

tg.callText: [strong] Listed Questionable, and ESPN's Jeremy Fowler reports Spears (knee) is expected to play Sunday against the Jaguars. Fowler's report is the newest available, but its date is unconfirmed. Independent checking was limited: a StatChasers page last updated Nov 3 shows him Out for Week 8 at CIN (Nov 1) wi

injury.comment: Johnson carried the ball 10 times for 42 yards in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.
injury.longComment: The former Steeler led the Packers' backfield in totes and rushing yards, with MarShawn Lloyd chipping in 39 scrimmage yards on seven touches. Johnson has produced modest but decent numbers over the last two games, averaging a 4.6 YPC on 24 carries as the top early-down option for Green Bay. Josh Jacobs (finger) could return after the team's Week 11 bye, but if he isn't cleared, Johnson could find himself atop the depth chart again in Week 12 against the Rams.

injury.comment: Coleman, who was evaluated for a head injury, was later cleared to return to Sunday's game against the Jets.
injury.longComment: Coleman previously headed to the blue medical tent after taking a big hit during the contest, per Matt Parrino of News 4 Buffalo. However, after getting checked out, Coleman returned to the field to rejoin a WR corps that also includes DJ Moore and Khalil Shakir.

injury.comment: The Cowboys placed Goodson (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Tommy Yarrish of the team's official site reports.
injury.longComment: The move comes as no surprise, seeing as Goodson is expected to miss multiple games due to ACL and MCL sprains in his knee that he suffered during the Cowboys' Week 9 victory over the Colts. With Malik Davis (hip, IR) out for the year and Goodson now on IR, Israel Abanikanda -- who was elevated from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday -- will serve as Dallas' RB2 behind Javonte Williams for Sunday's game against the 49ers. Goodson is required to miss at least four games while on IR, so his next chance to play is Week 15 against the Rams on Sunday, Dec. 20.

tg.callText: Injured Reserve

injury.comment: Estime carried the ball seven times for six yards and caught his only target for five yards in Sunday's 20-17 loss to Carolina.
injury.longComment: Travis Etienne returned from IR and led the Saints' backfield with 11 touches, although he managed just 34 scrimmage yards, while Alvin Kamara handled five touches and scored two short TDs. Perhaps worse for Estime's role and future value, he was ineffective in short-yardage situations, getting stuffed on three attempts to pick up a first down from two yards out or less, and a miscommunication with Tyler Shough on a handoff led to a lost fumble in the second quarter, although the giveaway was charged to the QB. Estime will try to maintain some share of the workload in a Week 11 meeting with the Bears.

injury.comment: Robinson (ankle) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
injury.longComment: The Titans were already without Carnell Tate (shoulder) Sunday, and now,  Robinson's status will need to be monitored ahead of next weekend's game against the Cowboys. Next up for the team's WR snaps/targets should one or both of the aforementioned players be sidelined in Week 11 are Elic Ayomanor and Chimere Dike.

injury.comment: Robinson caught three passes for 22 yards on four targets in Sunday's 38-17 win over the Raiders.
injury.longComment: Playing in his first game since Week 2 due to a high ankle sprain, Robinson played 51 percent of the Niners' offensive snaps against Las Vegas. San Francisco's wideout situation is a week-to-week thing moving forward, with the Tuesday addition of Keenan Allen and Deebo Samuel (hamstring), Mike Evans (Achilles) and rookie De'Zhaun Stribling (ankle) all likely to return at some point in the near future. Robinson isn't someone to roster in 12-team fantasy leagues.

injury.comment: Davis rushed three times for eight yards in Sunday's 31-12 win over the Jets.
injury.longComment: Davis has been held to single-digit rushing yards in eight of nine games this season and has now managed to rush for just 52 empty yards on 16 carries for the season. He's nothing more than a bench stash in fantasy should something happen to James Cook.

injury.comment: Foot
Douglas brought in three of eight targets for 71 yards in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Douglas posted a team-high yardage total with a big hand from his game-long 38-yard grab. Douglas garnered plenty of first-time starter Kyle McCord's attention as evidenced by the receiver's team-high target tally, and he's now hit or exceeded the 70-yard mark in three of the past four games. The 2026 third-round pick will look to carry over the momentum into a tough Week 11 road matchup against the Bills next Sunday.

injury.comment: Warren rushed once for three yards and brought in two of three targets for one yard in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
injury.longComment: The new-look Colts offense was without Josh Downs and Keenan Allen after trade-deadline moves, but Warren was still surprisingly uninvolved. Daniel Jones completed only 50.0 percent of his passes and threw for just 108 yards, however, so Warren's minimal production is somewhat understandable in that context. Jones has thrown for under 200 yards in four consecutive games and is playing generally uninspired football, so Warren's fantasy outlook remains shaky for the time being but could improve if Anthony Richardson takes over under center at some point.

injury.comment: Strong (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Vikings.
injury.longComment: Strong is a healthy scratch despite Josh Jacobs (finger) being unable to suit up for Sunday's game. MarShawn Lloyd will be the Packers' starter for the divisional contest, with Chris Brooks and Kaleb Johnson set to fulfill reserve roles.

injury.comment: Worthy failed to catch any of his three targets in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Falcons.
injury.longComment: Worthy ran a team-high 37 routes on Patrick Mahomes' 38 dropbacks, but on a day Mahomes targeted nine different players, Worthy was the only one to not record a catch. With Josh Downs now in the fold and working to get comfortable in the offense, Worthy's role will likely only continue to shrink. On just eight routes in his team debut Sunday, Downs posted a 4-53-1 receiving line on five targets. Worthy hasn't produced that many fantasy points in a game all season. He's waiver-wire fodder in 12-team redraft leagues.

tg.callText: [strong] He was a full participant in practice on Wednesday, Nov. 11, and coach Andy Reid had already called him "day-to-day" after he left Sunday's game with an apparent hamstring injury, so there's nothing pointing toward him sitting.

injury.comment: Beck was 11-for-18 passing for 108 yards, no touchdowns and two interceptions and had one rush for one yard during Sunday's 34-6 loss to the Rams.
injury.longComment: The Cardinals traded Jacoby Brissett to the Ravens after Week 8, and then Gardner Minshew tore the UCL in his right elbow in Week 9, setting the stage for the first appearance (a start) of Beck's career. Beck, a rookie third-rounder, generated just two drives of 30-plus yards among his nine possessions overall, and two others ended in interceptions in Rams territory. He also didn't find much success with his top available skill-position talent, TE Trey McBride, who gathered in all five of his targets for 37 yards. They'll look to improve their rapport next Sunday in Kansas City.

injury.comment: Demercado rushed seven times for 16 yards and brought in one of two targets for minus-1 yard in the Texans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Demercado opened the game as a reserve in his second appearance in a Texans uniform, but Woody Marks' third-quarter exit due to a concussion left the former in the de facto No. 1 role. That still didn't lead to much opportunity for Demercado in a game during which Houston squandered a 17-0 first-half lead. However, DJ Bien-Aime of ESPN.com reports Marks is unlikely to play in Week 11 due to the short turnaround for a home matchup against the Colts, meaning Demercado and Dare Ogunbowale could have expanded roles in that game unless David Montgomery (groin) is able to suit up.

injury.comment: Herbert carried the ball once for seven yards and caught two of his three targets for two yards during Atlanta's loss to the Bengals on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Herbert continued to serve a limited role in his first game since being signed to the active roster from the practice squad, as he played just 11 snaps on offense and nine on special teams. With Brian Robinson (hamstring) set to miss at least another three games, Herbert will likely continue to serve as the team's backup running back behind Bijan Robinson.

injury.comment: Meyers caught three of six targets for 34 yards in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans.
injury.longComment: The six targets were second on the Jaguars behind Parker Washington's nine, but Meyers' longest gain of the day went for only 15 yards. The veteran wideout has also failed to find the end zone in six straight games, a stretch in which he's managed just a 19-256-0 line on 32 targets. Meyers will try to end that drought in a Week 11 clash against the Giants.
