injury.comment: Higbee (illness) and Colby Parkinson (rib) have both been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the Cardinals, while fellow tight end Davis Allen (oblique) is listed as questionable, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.
injury.longComment: With wideout Puka Nacua (knee) placed on injured reserve this week, there's renewed fantasy interest in the Rams' tight ends. Higbee has run a lot of routes without providing production in recent games, but both he and Parkinson could see more targets over the next few weeks, including Sunday in a favorable matchup with Arizona's subpar pass defense.

injury.comment: Wilson (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game at Arizona.
injury.longComment: Since Zach Charbonnet and Jadarian Price returned to the lineup in Week 8 against the Bears, Wilson was contained to special teams in that contest and then was active but didn't log a snap last Sunday versus the Cardinals. Now, Wilson will yield all the RB reps to Charbonnet, Price and George Holani in Week 10.

injury.comment: Wright (quadriceps) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, C. Isaiah Smalls II of the Miami Herald reports.
injury.longComment: After missing last Sunday's loss to the Lions, Wright figures to be back in as the lightly used RB2 behind Ollie Gordon, though Wright has not produced when on the field this season. He's averaged 1.9 yards per carry on 22 attempts and is virtually a zero in the passing game.

injury.comment: Shaheed caught one pass for eight yards on two targets in Sunday's 21-13 win over the Raiders.
injury.longComment: After missing the previous two games with a knee injury, Shaheed returned against Las Vegas and maintained his role as the WR3 for Seattle. He played 25 of 57 offensive snaps and remained a non-factor in the box score. Shaheed has yet to hit 70 receiving yards in a game this season and has zero touchdowns as a pass catcher. He's off the fantasy radar.

injury.comment: Strange caught two of three targets for nine yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans.
injury.longComment: The Jaguars keep blowing out their opponents, and Strange contributed a three-yard touchdown Sunday but was otherwise not heard from much, as Parker Washington dog-walked the Titans' secondary for 7-152-1 receiving on nine targets. Strange's touchdown grab was his first since Week 1. He remans a locked-in TE1 for fantasy, as he is playing virtually every snap in an elite offense.

injury.comment: Dalton is inactive for Sunday's game against the Chiefs but was designated as his team's emergency third quarterback.
injury.longComment: Dalton remains the third option behind Michael Penix and Tua Tagovailoa. The "Red Rifle" will only enter Sunday's game if both Penix and Tagovailoa must exit the contest due to injury, illness or ejection.

injury.comment: inactive
The Bills elevated Buechele from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday.
injury.longComment: It's the first time this season that Buechele has been elevated from the practice squad. He'll likely operate as the Bills' emergency third quarterback behind Josh Allen and Kyle Allen for Sunday's game against the Jets.

injury.comment: Mills completed one of two pass attempts for seven yards and lost two yards on two carries in Sunday's 44-22 win over the Chargers.
injury.longComment: Since the Texans had built their lead to 19 with less than five minutes remaining in the fourth quarter, head coach DeMeco Ryans opted to pull starting quarterback C.J. Stroud from the game and handed the offense over to Mills. In what marked his first playing time of the season, Mills directed two possessions. He led the Texans to a field goal with 2:20 remaining, then knelt twice to run out the clock when Houston got the ball back with 1:07 left. With Stroud enjoying a bounce-back campaign, Mills' opportunities will likely be limited to garbage-time situations if Stroud stays healthy.

Gabriel (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Texans but will serve as the Browns' emergency third quarterback.
injury.longComment: Gabriel was the backup to Shedeur Sanders for Week 9 against the Saints. With Deshaun Watson clearing concussion protocol, Sanders will revert to QB2 duties while Gabriel operates as the emergency third quarterback. That means Gabriel is not allowed to play unless Watson and Sanders both leave the game due to injury, illness or ejection.

injury.comment: inactive
Leonard (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Colts' emergency third quarterback against the Dolphins on Sunday.
injury.longComment: As he's done all season, Leonard will be Indianapolis' emergency QB3, which means he is not allowed to play Sunday unless both Daniel Jones and Anthony Richardson leave the game due to injury, illness or ejection.

injury.comment: Nussmeier (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Chiefs' emergency third quarterback against the Falcons on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Nussmeier will continue to be the Chiefs' emergency third quarterback, which means he is prohibited from playing Sunday unless both Patrick Mahomes and Justin Fields leave the game due to injury, illness or ejection.

injury.comment: O'Connell moves to QB No. 2 on the depth chart behind Fernando Mendoza, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.
injury.longComment: O'Connell is set to back up rookie Mendoza, who replaced recently traded Kirk Cousins as the starting quarterback. O'Connell has been with Las Vegas since the team drafted him in the fourth round of the 2023 NFL Draft. The 28-year-old last appeared in a regular-season game in 2025, completing 10 of 22 attempts for 102 yards.

injury.comment: Simpson (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Rams' emergency third quarterback in Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
injury.longComment: Simpson continues to be inactive behind Matthew Stafford and Stetson Bennett. The quarterback will only enter the game if both Stafford and Bennett must exit due to injury, illness or ejection.

injury.comment: Undisclosed

McCord completed 17 of 32 passes for 209 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions and rushed twice for four yards and a touchdown in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday. He also lost a fumble that was returned for a touchdown.
injury.longComment: Drawing his first career start as a result of Malik Willis having gone on injured reserve with an abdomen injury earlier in the week, McCord acquitted himself well overall in a favorable matchup. The 2025 sixth-round pick of the Eagles spread the ball around to nine different targets, and he had a statement three-yard touchdown run on the first play of the fourth quarter when he powered through a pair of defenders and broke the plane despite having his facemask pulled. McCord's one turnover was very costly, however, as it was recovered on the Dolphins' six-yard line and returned for a short touchdown. McCord should only get more comfortable by following up Sunday's solid showing with another week of practice, but he'll draw a tough Week 11 road matchup against the Bills next Sunday.

injury.comment: The Dolphins elevated Cook from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday.
injury.longComment: The Dolphins placed Malik Willis (abdomen) on injured reserve Tuesday, so Cook will operate as the team's backup quarterback behind Kyle McCord for Sunday's game against the Colts. Cook appeared in five regular-season games (four starts) for the Jets in 2025, when he completed 57.5 percent of his passes for 739 yards, two touchdowns and seven interceptions while rushing for 49 yards on 13 carries.

injury.comment: Brosmer (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Vikings' emergency third quarterback against the Packers on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Brosmer was the Vikings' backup for Week 9 against the Bills and ended up seeing the field late in the fourth quarter, when he completed six of seven pass attempts for 58 yards. The Vikings acquired Kirk Cousins from the Raiders on Tuesday, and he will serve as Minnesota's starter Sunday while Carson Wentz operates as the backup. With Kyler Murray (hamstring) sidelined, that leaves Brosmer as the emergency QB3, which prohibits the latter from playing unless both Cousins and Wentz leave the game due to injury, illness or ejection.

injury.comment: Wilson (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Saints' emergency third quarterback against the Panthers on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Wilson is the No. 3 quarterback behind Tyler Shough and Spencer Rattler. The inactive third option will only enter Sunday's game if Shough and Rattler must leave the contest due to injury, illness or ejection.

injury.comment: Klubnik completed 11 of 20 passes for 137 yards, no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 31-12 loss to the Bills. He added three rushing attempts for 26 yards.
injury.longComment: Klubnik saw the first regular-season action of his NFL career in the second half of Sunday's loss, as Geno Smith (ankle) exited the game. The rookie fourth-round pick led the offense down to Buffalo's four-yard line on his first possession in the third quarter, but the Jets settled for a field goal on that possession, and Klubnik was picked off on his next drive. If Smith isn't ready to return in Week 11, Klubnik would be in line to make his first regular-season start on the road against the Chargers.

injury.comment: The 49ers fielded trade inquiries for Jones from the Vikings leading up to Tuesday's deadline, but the quarterback is expected to remain in San Francisco, Dianna Russini of BetUS TV reports.
injury.longComment: Even though starting quarterback Brock Purdy has been a leading MVP candidate through the halfway point of the season, the 49ers still place a premium value on Jones as an insurance option in the event Purdy misses time due to injury. As such, the 49ers' asking price for Jones was too rich for the Vikings, who have since pivoted their focus to acquiring Kirk Cousins from the Raiders.

injury.comment: inactive
King (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the emergency third quarterback against the Saints on Sunday, Darin Gantt of the Panthers' official site reports.
injury.longComment: As the emergency QB3, Gantt is prohibited from playing Sunday unless both Bryce Young and Kenny Pickett leave the game due to injury, illness or ejection.

injury.comment: Aguilar (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the emergency third quarterback against the Rams on Sunday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.
injury.longComment: With Jacoby Brissett being traded to Baltimore on Nov. 6 and Gardner Minshew (elbow, IR) out for the rest of the season, the Cardinals overhauled their QB room by signing both Josh Johnson and Aguilar earlier this week, with Carson Beck now serving as the starter. As the emergency third quarterback, Aguilar is not allowed to play Sunday unless both Beck and Johnson leave the game due to injury, illness or ejection.

injury.comment: Robinson (hamstring) was placed on injured reserve Saturday, Marc Raimondi of ESPN.com reports.
injury.longComment: Robinson already has missed two games due to a lingering hamstring injury and now must miss at least the next four outings, meaning his next chance for game action is Sunday, Dec. 13 at Cleveland. In a corresponding move, the Falcons are signing Khalil Herbert from the practice squad to the active roster to continue serving as the No. 2 RB behind workhorse Bijan Robinson.

injury.comment: Undisclosed
The Texans signed Ogunbowale to the practice squad and elevated him to the active roster Saturday.
injury.longComment: Ogunbowale was released by the Texans on Thursday after appearing in each of the team's five prior games. He's opted to stay in Houston as a member of the practice squad, and his elevation to the 53-man roster comes after David Montgomery (groin) was ruled out for Sunday's game against the Browns. Ogunbowale and Emari Demercado will provide depth for the Texans behind lead back Woody Marks in Week 10.

injury.longComment: Burton was already ruled out for Sunday's game against the Texans due to a calf injury that he picked up against the Saints in Week 9. Since the Browns do not have another fullback on the 53-man roster, the team will likely turn to tight ends Carsen Ryan, Zaire Mitchell-Paden and Blake Whiteheart to provide blocking out of the backfield, per Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com.

Brooks got some modest run with the Packers offense before he was sidelined, turning 15 rushes into 70 yards (4.7 YPC) and three catches (on five targets) for 24 yards, but he's most valuable in pass protection for QB Jordan Love.

injury.comment: Hutchinson brought in four of nine targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in the Texans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Hutchinson, who was checked for a concussion during the fourth quarter, finished second across the board in receptions, receiving yards and targets for the Texans. He also recorded a touchdown grab for the third straight game on an 11-yard catch early in the second quarter, and his receiving yardage tally was his highest since Week 5. Hutchinson now sports a 28-345-3 receiving line on 54 targets as he continues to function in a steady complementary role heading into a Week 11 home matchup against the Colts on Thursday night.

injury.comment: Mumpfield brought in three of four targets for 81 yards in the Rams' 34-6 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
injury.longComment: With Puka Nacua (knee/toe) and Davante Adams (hamstring) on injured reserve, Mumpfield operated as the de facto No. 1 receiver for Matthew Stafford. Mumpfield met the moment with a team-high receiving yardage total that more than doubled that of the next-closest pass catcher, Xavier Smith (40 yards). The 2025 seventh-round pick has now cleared the 80-yard mark twice this season, but Mumpfield could slide down to the No. 2 role in a Week 12 Thanksgiving Eve home matchup against the Packers on Nov. 25 if Adams is able to finish his recovery over the upcoming Week 11 bye.

injury.comment: Johnson caught two passes for 28 yards on three targets in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Panthers.
injury.longComment: With Jordyn Tyson playing his second game since debuting last week, the rookie wideout was targeted 13 times on Tyler Shough's 35 pass attempts. It didn't leave much for the rest of New Orleans' pass catchers, as Travis Etienne was actually second on the team with five targets. Over his last five games, Johnson has nine catches for 85 yards and a score. He's become a low-end TE2 for fantasy.

injury.comment: Dell brought in three of four targets for 21 yards and rushed once for no gain in the Texans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.
injury.longComment: One week after posting a 105-yard effort against the Chargers in only his second game since 2024, Dell saw a big downturn in yardage Sunday. Nevertheless, the fact he retained a solid complementary role was encouraging, and the speedy wideout seems to be playing unencumbered by any physical or mental limitations following the recovery from his devastating knee injury. Dell will look to boost his yardage back up in a favorable Week 11 home matchup against the Colts on Thursday night.

injury.longComment: Barner has been held below 25 receiving yards in eight of 10 games this season and has more rushing touchdowns (two) than receiving scores (one) during the 2026 campaign. He's the definition of a low-floor, touchdown-or-bust fantasy option headed into the team's bye week.

injury.comment: Pitts brought in four of five targets for 50 yards in the Falcons' 35-13 loss to the Chiefs on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.
injury.longComment: The veteran tight end had a slow start to the day before coming on when the Falcons went especially pass-heavy in the second half. Pitts' fumble, his first of the season, came with just over four minutes remaining in the game after the contest was out of reach, and his catch total was his highest since Week 7. Pitts remains a key complementary option in an Atlanta passing attack that's scuffled of late, and he'll look to bounce back after the Falcons emerge from a Week 11 bye with a Week 12 road matchup against the Vikings on Sunday, Nov. 29.

injury.comment: Thomas caught three of four targets for 29 yards in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans.
injury.longComment: The three catches tied his season high, while the four targets represented his biggest volume since Week 2. The Jaguars' decision not to deal Thomas at the trade deadline remains a curious one, as the third-year wideout simply doesn't have a significant role in Liam Coen's offense and might not step into one even if someone like Parker Washington got injured -- Josh Cameron was more productive Sunday on three targets and caught one of Trevor Lawrence's three TDs. Thomas will take a 13-146-2 line on 26 targets over nine games into a Week 11 tilt against the Giants.

injury.longComment: Despite playing 84 percent of the offensive snaps, Dotson's two targets were a distant sixth on the team against Cincinnati. He has 16 catches for 33 yards and two touchdowns on 33 targets through nine games this season and isn't a particularly exciting fantasy option fighting for scraps behind Drake London, Bijan Robinson and Kyle Pitts in Atlanta.

injury.comment: Kupp caught three of four targets for 32 yards during the Seahawks' 17-3 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
injury.longComment: All three of Kupp's catches came on the same offensive drive midway through the third quarter, which ended with a 45-yard field goal by Jason Myers. The Seahawks had Drew Lock under center due to the absence of Sam Darnold (quadriceps/ribs), but Lock is now dealing with an oblique injury that could prevent him from playing in Week 10 against the Raiders on Nov. 15. Jalen Milroe would be the next man up at quarterback for Seattle, which would lower the floors for Kupp and the rest of the Seahawks' pass catchers. Kupp has a 22-238-2 receiving line on 34 targets through nine regular-season games.

injury.comment: Waller caught two of four targets for 24 yards in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Saints.
injury.longComment: One week after his 8-90-1 receiving outburst, Waller came back to normalcy in the Panthers' three-man committee at tight end. Waller has big upside, but his ceiling games are difficult to predict. He's been held below 40 yards with no touchdowns in five of nine games this season. Waller will be a low-floor TE2 with upside for Week 11 against the Ravens.

injury.comment: Cooks (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.
injury.longComment: Mike Evans (Achilles) is also inactive for a third consecutive game, but Cooks' services are not needed Sunday due to the return of Deebo Samuel (hamstring) and the acquisition of Keenan Allen from the Colts on Tuesday. It's unclear if Cooks will have any role in the 49ers' offense once Evans is cleared to return. For now, Cooks' next chance to suit up is Week 11 against the Vikings on Nov. 22.

injury.longComment: A 2026 fifth-round pick, Virgil started his career buried on the depth chart before moving up due to injuries and trades. It's not quite the same as earning a starting job, but he should see routes and targets all the same in the coming weeks. Virgil has been targeted on 11 of 56 routes (19.6 percent) and caught just three passes for 54 yards in five appearances. He should get plenty of playing time this Sunday against the Rams in what will be the first career start for rookie QB Carson Beck.

Legette was a full participant in practice throughout Week 10 prep, so he could immediately step back in as the Panthers' No. 3 wideout, the role he held prior to succumbing to the knee injury.

injury.longComment: Cameron gave the Jaguars a 14-point lead early in the fourth quarter when he hauled in a 25-yard touchdown pass from Trevor Lawrence. It was the rookie wideout's third touchdown of the campaign but his first since Week 3. Cameron's 67 receiving yards marked a career high, while his three receptions tied the most he's had as a pro. Cameron's propensity for finding the end zone (his three TDs have come on just 12 total catches) is appealing, but at this point he isn't getting enough volume to be a reliable week-to-week fantasy asset.

injury.comment: Ayomanor caught five of 10 targets for 79 yards in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars.

If they both remain on the shelf in Week 11 against the Cowboys, Ayomanor figures to handle an increased role once again. The second-year WR sports an 18-290-1 line on 36 targets through nine games on the year.

injury.comment: Metchie caught both of his targets for 40 yards Sunday in a loss to the Broncos.
injury.longComment: Both of Metchie's receptions came in the second half -- he brought in a 15-yarder midway through the third quarter and added a 25-yarder near the end of the fourth. The latter catch took the ball down to Denver's nine-yard line and set up a Panthers touchdown, but Carolina ultimately was unable to complete the comeback. Metchie has been consistent but relatively unremarkable this season, logging either two or three receptions in six straight games but not surpassing Sunday's 40 yards in any of those contests.

injury.comment: Head coach Shane Steichen said that Dulin will be one of the Colts receivers tasked with absorbing the snaps vacated by Keenan Allen, who was traded to the 49ers on Tuesday, Jake Arthur of Roundtable.io reports.
injury.longComment: Steichen also mentioned Deion Burks and Nick Westbrook-Ikhine as other candidates to fill in at the outside receiver spot opposite Laquon Treadwell, while noting that Anthony Gould will serve as the Colts' starting slot receiver after the team also traded Josh Downs to the Chiefs on Tuesday. With Alec Pierce's (heel) return from injured reserve seemingly not imminent, Dulin could have a prime opportunity to see extended snaps over the next few weeks, provided he can hold off the likes of Burks and Westbrook-Ikhine for playing time. Dulin already made a bit of a splash in the Colts' Week 9 loss to the Cowboys, connecting with Daniel Jones on a 55-yard touchdown reception while also carrying once for a three-yard gain.

injury.comment: Nailor caught two of four targets for nine yards during Sunday's 38-17 loss to the 49ers.
injury.longComment: Nailor was a non-factor on offense in Week 9, failing to reach double-digit receiving yards for the fourth time this season. The wide receiver has had a hard time getting into a groove in his first season with Las Vegas, catching 14 of 28 targets for 122 yards and a touchdown over eight contests so far.

With Kirk Cousins' efficiency off to Minnesota, Mayer is a low-floor TE2 for fantasy, but he could get a bit of a boost if Brock Bowers' ankle injury causes him to miss time.

Zaccheaus isn't a key piece in the Falcons' offense, and that's unlikely to change heading into Week 10 against the Chiefs on Nov. 15.

Instead, his hip injury kept him out of drills until Week 7, when his 21-day window opened, but he sat out the last two games before Atlanta finally activated him Saturday. With Zachariah Branch sidelined Sunday due to a hamstring issue, Collins will serve as a reserve WR along with Chris Blair behind Drake London, Jahan Dotson and Olamide Zaccheaus.

However, he was not activated from the PUP list before the 4:00 p.m. ET deadline Saturday, so he will have to wait at least one more week before making his 2026 debut. Shavers' next chance to play is Week 11 against the Dolphins on Sunday, Nov. 22.

He won't necessarily see a lot of targets in an offense that runs through the RBs and TEs, but Burks should at least get far more playing time in the second half of the season, if only because the Colts' other wideouts are veterans with minimal history of production. Laquon Treadwell and Ashton Dulin are the other favorites for regular playing time, and Nick Westbrook-Ikhine is also on the roster.

If Watkins sees the field against the Dolphins on Sunday, then it would mark his first regular-season appearance since 2023 as a member of the Eagles, when he appeared in nine regular-season games and accumulated 15 catches (on 21 targets) for 142 yards and a touchdown.

injury.comment: Allen caught two of four targets for 44 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Falcons.
injury.longComment: The rookie wideout scored his first career touchdown by beating the cornerback on a stutter-go for a 39-yard touchdown in the third quarter. With Josh Downs still getting comfortable and learning the offense following Tuesday's acquisition from the Colts, Allen maintained a significant role on offense, playing 22 of 64 offensive snaps. Once Downs progresses from the 10 snaps he played against Atlanta, it will be interesting to see if Allen can push Xavier Worthy (zero catches on three targets across 56 snaps on Sunday) for a larger piece of the outside receiver role in Kansas City's offense.

injury.comment: Armstrong caught his only target for a 43-yard touchdown in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Falcons.
injury.longComment: The wideout played just 17 of 64 offensive snaps against Atlanta and ran only seven pass routes on Patrick Mahomes' 38 dropbacks. Armstrong was tasked with blocking duties on 10 of his snaps. He still managed to catch his first career touchdown in the fourth quarter with the game already well out of hand. Armstrong is not on the fantasy radar.

injury.longComment: Remigio appeared in each of the Chiefs' first eight games of the regular season before being cut by the team Tuesday. He predominantly served on special teams as a returner on kickoffs and punts with Kansas City, and he figures to reprise that role in Houston, although he'll be competing for that role with Tremon Smith, Tank Dell, Woody Marks and Xavier Hutchinson.

Though he seems fairly secure in the No. 3 wideout role, Bech hasn't done much this season, producing no more than three catches or 25 yards in any of his five games to date.

It's been determined by medical staff that the second-year wide receiver will not play in Sunday's contest, and Thornton has yet to play in a regular-season game in 2026 after appearing in 15 contests during his rookie campaign. Dareke Young and Cody White will operate as the depth options at wide receiver behind Tre Tucker, Jalen Nailor and Jack Bech.

injury.comment: Benson (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.
injury.longComment: Benson is a healthy scratch for a third consecutive week. The rookie sixth-rounder has failed to find a place in a wide-open receiving corps so far, and it remains to be seen how coach Klint Kubiak will utilize him.

injury.comment: Head coach Sean McVay said Friday that Daniels "will get an opportunity to play more snaps moving forward," Stu Jackson of the Rams' official site reports.
injury.longComment: Daniels has seen minimal playing time this season, but he'll be thrust into a more prominent role offensively due to both Puka Nacua (knee/toe) and Davante Adams (hamstring) being on injured reserve. As such, Daniels -- a sixth-round selection of the Rams in the 2026 NFL Draft -- is slated to serve as the team's WR3 behind Konata Mumpfield and Tutu Atwell for Sunday's game against the Cardinals, with Xavier Smith and Brennan Presley also in the mix for snaps on offense. During his final college season in Miami, Daniels recorded 50 catches for 557 yards and seven touchdowns across 13 games.

injury.comment: According to Ian Rapoport of NFL Network and ESPN,  Adams (hamstring) is believed to be targeting a return to action Nov. 25 against the Packers.
injury.longComment: Rapoport also noted Sunday that Adams' fellow WR Puka Nacua (knee/toe) has an estimated return in the mid-December range. For now, Konata Mumpfield and Tutu Atwell are in line to lead the WR corps of the Rams (who are on bye in Week 11), with CJ Daniels, Xavier Smith and Brennan Presley also on hand.

injury.comment: The Rams signed Presley to the 53-man roster Thursday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.
injury.longComment: Los Angeles is hurting at wide receiver, so the team signed Presley to bolster depth. The 24-year-old has appeared in just one game during his NFL career since going undrafted in 2025, though he spent all of his time on special teams.

injury.comment: Coleman wasn't targeted in Sunday's 19-9 loss to the Lions. He rushed one time for 16 yards.
injury.longComment: Coleman logged just 11 offensive snaps, and he's settled back in as the Dolphins' fourth receiver with all three of Malik Washington, Caleb Douglas and Chris Bell healthy ahead of him on the depth chart. Coleman, a fifth-round rookie out of Missouri has no fantasy appeal.

injury.comment: Tolbert caught both of his targets for 49 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 24-22 loss to the Colts.
injury.longComment: The wideout was active for just the fifth time in nine games this season and played 11 of 69 offensive snaps. He ran only five routes and caught a 34-yard touchdown from fellow receiver Malik Washington on a trick play early in the second quarter. Tolbert has no fantasy appeal moving forward, as he has just four catches for 79 yards on six targets this season.

injury.comment: inactive

injury.comment: The Dolphins elevated Reagor from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday.
injury.longComment: The move gives the Dolphins extra depth at wide receiver, as rookie third-rounder Chris Bell (knee) is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Colts. If Reagor sees the field in Week 10, then it would be the veteran wide receiver's first regular-season game since 2024, when he logged seven catches (on 12 targets) for 100 yards across eight games as a member of the Chargers.

injury.comment: Felton went without a target while playing six of the Vikings' 48 offensive snaps in Monday's 23-6 loss to the Bills.
injury.longComment: Felton continues to handle a muted role as a depth receiver for Minnesota, as Monday marked the third consecutive game in which he played single-digit snaps. For the season, the second-year wideout out of Maryland has been limited to just three receptions for 41 yards on seven targets over eight appearances.

injury.comment: Price caught all four targets for 49 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers.
injury.longComment: With Jordan Addison (thumb) inactive, Price moved up the depth chart and played 33 of 69 offensive snaps behind Justin Jefferson (63) and Tai Felton (59) in Kirk Cousins' 2026 debut with the team. Price ended up running 22 routes on Cousins' 36 dropbacks and produced the game's first touchdown, scoring from 38 yards out in the first quarter to give Minnesota a 10-0 lead. On limited offensive playing time this season, Price has recorded 10 catches for 81 yards and the one touchdown on 15 targets. He's unlikely to be a fantasy factor moving forward.

injury.comment: Jones (shoulder) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Packers.
injury.longComment: Jones is being evaluated by medical staff to determine whether he can return to Sunday's game. He was a practice squad elevation Saturday to give the Vikings more depth at wide receiver due to the absences of both Jordan Addison (thumb) and Jauan Jennings (calf).

injury.comment: Brown caught his only target for 52 yards during Sunday's 23-22 overtime win versus the Browns. He also lost a fumble on a punt return.
injury.longComment: Brown showed off his plus speed in the second quarter, blowing by safety Ronnie Hickman and coming down with a 52-yard bomb from quarterback Tyler Shough. One series later, though, he coughed up the football during an erratic punt return. Barring an injury to one of the wideouts ahead of him on New Orleans' depth chart, there likely won't be much room in the short term for him to earn a significant role outside of special teams.

injury.comment: Groin
Williams did not draw a target in Sunday's Week 9 loss to Kansas City. However, he rushed once for four yards, returned one punt for 18 yards and returned two kickoffs for 55 yards.
injury.longComment: Williams didn't get a ball thrown his way despite logging a 60 percent offensive snap share. While the Illinois product continues to have a role in multiple facets of the game for New York, he's not making much of an impact as a pass catcher. Williams has one or zero catches in five straight contests and has tallied only 34 receiving yards during that span.

injury.comment: Patrick (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Bills.
injury.longComment: Garrett Wilson (concussion), Omar Cooper (ankle) and Adonai Mitchell (knee) have all been cleared to play Sunday, so Patrick will observe from the sidelines. Patrick hasn't played since Week 7 against the Dolphins, and his next opportunity to suit up is Week 11 against the Chargers on Nov. 22.

injury.comment: Knee
Fehoko will take over a larger role after teammate Michael Wilson suffered a season-ending neck injury last week, Zach Gershman of the Cardinals' official site reports.
injury.longComment: Fehoko is a 2021 fifth-round pick who turned 29 earlier this month and has been targeted on just two of 37 routes for the Cardinals this year. He mostly seems to have stuck around the league because his size is useful for special teams and blocking, but Fehoko now has a chance to get more snaps on offense, if only because Arizona's WR depth chart has been decimated. He has a chance to start this Sunday against the Rams in QB Carson Beck's first career start.

injury.longComment: Jones signed with the Cardinals' practice squad Oct. 28, and this is his first elevation since joining the organization. The veteran wideout could immediately slide into a major role in Arizona's passing game among a depleted wideout corps that has lost Michael Wilson (neck) and Kendrick Bourne (tibia) for the season. Jones spent the past two campaigns with the Cardinals, and he caught 12 passes (on 18 targets) for 182 yards over eight games last year.

injury.longComment: With the Rams down both Puka Nacua (knee/toe) and Davante Adams (hamstring) for the first time this season, Smith operated as the fourth receiver against Arizona, playing nine of 76 offensive snaps. His 22-yard touchdown in the second quarter was the first of Smith's career. Based on his small amount of playing time and routes run, Smith's 12-point PPR day isn't worth chasing in fantasy.

Williams (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Titans.
injury.longComment: The rookie sixth-rounder will once again be a healthy scratch, and he hasn't seen regular-season action since his debut in Week 1 against the Browns. Williams' next chance to play is Week 11 against the Giants on Nov. 22, but he is unlikely to play unless there is an absence ahead of him on the Jaguars' wide-receiver depth chart.

injury.comment: Parkinson (ribs) and Tyler Higbee (illness) have been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the Cardinals, while fellow tight end Davis Allen (oblique) is listed as questionable, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.
injury.longComment: Parkinson hasn't shown much hint of matching last year's TD-fueled fantasy production, but he could see more targets in the coming weeks with both Puka Nacua (knee) and Davante Adams (hamstring) on injured reserve. Konata Mumpfield and Tutu Atwell are the favorites for WR snaps, likely leaving the RBs and TEs to handle a larger-than-usual portion of Matthew Stafford's targets. Of course, the Rams will probably want to run the ball more often while their top receiving weapons are sidelined.

injury.comment: Helm caught all four of his targets for 23 yards in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars.
injury.longComment: After a career day last time out in Week 8 against the Bengals, Helm's box score looked more familiar against Jacksonville's stout defense. He's been held below 30 yards in eight of nine games this season and has yet to catch a touchdown. Helm is a member of the large bucket of low-floor TE2 options in fantasy.

injury.comment: Taylor recorded one catch for 11 yards on two targets in Sunday's 35-12 loss to the Chiefs.
injury.longComment: Even with Garrett Wilson (concussion) inactive, Taylor's two targets were his fewest in a game since Week 2, and he left that one early with a thumb injury. It was Kenyon Sadiq who had Geno Smith's eyes against Kansas City, as the rookie tight end recorded four grabs for 49 yards on four targets. Taylor is more of a touchdown-or-bust fantasy option at the position.

injury.comment: Tremble caught four of six targets for 24 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-21 loss to the Broncos.
injury.longComment: The Panthers continue to use three tight ends heavily on offense, and Tremble has settled in as the do-it-all tight member of the trio, while Darren Waller is solely a pass catcher and Mitchell Evans focuses on blocking. Tremble doesn't have nearly the upside of Waller, but the former still draws Bryce Young's eye in the red zone. On the year, Tremble is up to 21 grabs for 179 yards and three touchdowns on 30 targets across eight games. He's not an exciting fantasy option.

injury.comment: Fant Donaldson (back) upgraded to full participation at Thursday's practice.
injury.longComment: Fant was limited at Wednesday's practice, but the veteran TE faced no limitations Thursday, suggesting that he'll be good to go for Sunday's game against the Panthers. He has worked as the Saints' No. 2 option at the position behind Juwan Johnson.

tg.callText: [lean] He was a limited participant Wed Nov 11 with a back issue he may have tweaked in Week 9. He has two practices left to increase his participation before Sunday, and nothing suggests the injury is serious. Thursday's (Nov 12) report was not found.

injury.comment: Allen (oblique) is active for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
injury.longComment: Allen has recovered enough from the oblique injury he suffered during the Rams' Week 9 win over the Commanders to suit up for Week 10. The No. 3 tight end is a key part of the Rams' 13-personnel offense, and he should continue seeing a significant share of offensive snaps for the team.

injury.comment: Boerkircher hauled in two of three targets for 61 yards in Thursday night's 33-10 win over Baltimore.
injury.longComment: Boerkircher was tied with Parker Washington for the second-most receiving yards on the team with 61. This game marks the fourth time this season that the rookie has surpassed 30 snaps on offense. Boerkircher has made a name for himself as Jacksonville's No. 2 option at tight end behind Brenton Strange.

injury.comment: Moreau didn't log any targets or touches Sunday in a 44-22 win against the Chargers.
injury.longComment: For the second straight week, Moreau didn't make a mark in the box score. He did technically draw a target (which he didn't catch), but it was wiped out by an accepted defensive penalty. Moreau hasn't had more than two catches in any game this season and has finished with fewer than 10 yards in every contest since Week 3, so he's not a viable fantasy play in virtually any format right now.

injury.comment: Stover was a healthy inactive for Sunday's 44-22 win over the Chargers.
injury.longComment: Week 9 marked the first time all season that Stover sat out, with the Texans opting to keep their other four tight ends (Dalton Schultz, Foster Moreau, Brevin Jordan and Marlin Klein) active ahead of him. Through the Texans' first seven games, Stover had played less than half of the offensive snaps in each contest and recorded three receptions for 17 yards on five targets while rushing three times for five yards.

injury.comment: The Browns signed Ryan off the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Chris Easterling of the Akron Beacon Journal reports.
injury.longComment: The move corresponds with the Browns placing fullback Michael Burton (calf) on injured reserve. Ryan was a seventh-round selection of the Browns in the 2026 NFL Draft, and this is the second time in November that he has been signed to the 53-man roster. The rookie out of BYU has not seen a target through the first eight regular-season games of his NFL career, and he's expected to operate mostly on special teams while providing depth at tight end behind Harold Fannin and Blake Whiteheart.

injury.comment: Personal
Schoonmaker (groin) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.
injury.longComment: The tight end has missed the past two games for Dallas, but appears to be ready to return and could see significant snaps behind Brevyn Spann-Ford while Jake Ferguson (knee) is sidelined.

injury.comment: The Cowboys signed Mitchell from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Tommy Yarrish of the team's official site reports.
injury.longComment: The Cowboys technically still have one elevation to use on Mitchell this season, but they instead will opt to sign him to the active roster for Week 10. His signing gives the Cowboys extra depth at tight end, as the team will be without Jake Ferguson (knee) for Sunday's game against the 49ers.

injury.comment: Knee - ACL + MCL
Green Bay placed Whyle (concussion) on injured reserve Saturday.
injury.longComment: Whyle suffered a concussion in Week 8 against Carolina and missed last Sunday's win over the Patriots. He had already been ruled for Sunday's contest against Minnesota before the Packers decided to place him on IR. Whyle didn't log a catch or target during his eight contests before getting hurt, so his blocking and work on special teams will be the primary voids during his absence.

injury.comment: The Packers elevated Dabney from their practice squad to their active roster Saturday.
injury.longComment: It's the second straight week Dabney has been elevated. He didn't get any snaps on offense last Sunday against New England but did play six snaps on special teams. Josh Whyle (concussion) was placed on IR on Saturday, so Dabney is set to take Whyle's role as a depth tight end and contributor on special teams.

Mallory (hamstring) has been downgraded from questionable to out for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.
injury.longComment: Mallory was a late addition to the Colts' injury report due to a hamstring issue that cropped up Friday. The fourth-year pro will not be available for Sunday's contest, and with Mo Alie-Cox (groin) placed on injured reserve, Tyler Warren will be backed up by Drew Ogletree and Pharaoh Brown. Mallory's next chance to play is Week 11 against the Texans on Thursday.

injury.comment: The Colts placed Alie-Cox (groin) on injured reserve Saturday.
injury.longComment: Alie-Cox was already ruled out for Sunday's game against the Dolphins, and his groin injury is severe enough for him to warrant a stint on injured reserve. That means he'll be required to miss at least four games, and with the Colts on a bye for Week 13, that means the next time Alie-Cox can play is Week 15 against the Titans on Sunday, Dec. 20. Will Mallory (hamstring) has also been ruled out for Week 10, so Drew Ogletree and Pharaoh Brown will serve as the Colts' backup tight ends behind Tyler Warren against Miami.

injury.comment: Undisclosed
Wiley suffered a fractured ankle in the Chiefs' 35-13 victory over the Falcons on Sunday, Matt Derrick of ChiefsDigest.com reports.
injury.longComment: Wiley was carted to the locker room in the first quarter with an ankle injury. The tight end fractured his ankle and did not return to the contest. The 26-year-old will likely be placed on injured reserve soon, as he begins to recover from the injury.

injury.comment: Knee
The Raiders elevated Runyon from their practice squad to the active roster Saturday.
injury.longComment: Runyon began the season on IR due to a foot injury. He was activated Nov. 4 but was then waived the following day. Runyon subsequently returned to Las Vegas as part of the practice squad and could get his first regular-season game action of the campaign Sunday. However, the Raiders have three tight ends ahead of him on the depth chart (Brock Bowers, Michael Mayer and Ian Thomas), so Runyon may be limited to special teams if he does suit up.

injury.comment: Kacmarek (quadriceps) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Colts, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
injury.longComment: Kacmarek upgraded his practice participation in each Week 10 prep session. The tight end went from a non-participant Wednesday to a full participant by Friday's session. Kacmarek is all set to suit up as the No. 2 tight end behind Greg Dulcich for Sunday's game against the Colts.

injury.longComment: With T.J. Hockenson (wrist) inactive, Bartholomew played 53 of 69 offensive snaps against Green Bay and caught the second of Kirk Cousins' two touchdowns, scoring from 20 yards out in the fourth quarter to give Minnesota a comfortable 27-10 lead. While Ben Yurosek got the start, Bartholomew played 13 more snaps and out-targeted Yurosek four to one. Cousins has an affinity for throwing to his tight ends, so Bartholomew will be on the fantasy radar if Hockenson needs to miss more time.

injury.comment: Biceps
Culp was elevated from the Vikings' practice squad to their active roster Saturday.
injury.longComment: Culp signed with Minnesota's practice squad Oct. 28, and this is his first elevation since joining the organization. He last suited up for regular-season action in 2025 for Tampa Bay, when he caught his only target over 13 games for a six-yard touchdown. Assuming Culp is active Sunday, he'll boost the depth of a Vikings tight-end corps that will be without starter T.J. Hockenson (wrist).

Higgins is signing a contract extension with the Cardinals through 2029, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.
injury.longComment: Higgins was scheduled for free agency after this season, and he's taken on a larger role as the year has progressed, helping the Cardinals get by with limited talent at wide receiver. Higgins has 18 catches for 162 yards and a touchdown on 20 targets, serving as a complementary receiving option alongside Trey McBride when the Cardinals use multi-TE formations. Higgins figures to stick in that role long-term and won't be of much fantasy interest unless McBride misses time.

Long (knee) is active for Sunday's game against the Rams, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.
injury.longComment: Long was activated from injured reserve Saturday, and the sixth-year pro has been cleared to return from a five-game absence due to a knee injury. He will operate in a rotational role at tight end behind Trey McBride and Elijah Higgins.

Evans caught both of his two targets for 20 yards during Sunday's 26-21 loss versus the Broncos.
injury.longComment: For the third game in a row, Evans drew exactly two targets and caught both of them Sunday. With that said, he also again trailed in snaps at tight end (31) behind teammates Tommy Tremble (46) and Darren Waller (35), both of whom also drew more targets in Week 9. Evans' role in the Panthers' passing offense isn't big enough to warrant fantasy consideration in most formats going into a Week 10 matchup at New Orleans.

injury.comment: Sanders (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Saints, Darin Gantt of the Panthers' official site reports.
injury.longComment: Sanders made his 2026 regular-season debut in Week 9 against the Broncos, although he was limited to special teams in that contest. He's reverted to a healthy scratch for Week 10, and his next chance to play is Week 11 against the Ravens on Nov. 22.

injury.comment: Koziol finished Thursday's 33-10 win over Baltimore with two catches for 15 yards on two targets.
injury.longComment: Koziol was part of a three-tight-end starting unit for Jacksonville alongside Brenton Strange and Nate Boerkircher. Koziol logged the fewest offensive snaps (12) among the trio but matched both in receptions. He entered Thursday with just one catch through five contests, so it's probably not wise to count on him for substantial production moving forward.

injury.comment: The Browns elevated Mitchell-Paden from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Chris Easterling of the Akron Beacon Journal reports.
injury.longComment: The move gives the Browns another contributor on special teams and more depth at tight end for Sunday's game against the Texans. Mitchell-Paden has not appeared in a regular-season game since 2025, when he suited up for eight contests (six with Baltimore, two with New Orleans) and accumulated two catches (on three targets) for 17 yards.
